Abstract: Evaluating an aligned language model by reading its answers assumes the answers carry the distinction the evaluator cares about. We introduce LLM endognostics, a white-box internal auditing framework designed to extract and causally manipulate latent knowledge within the residual stream. Applied to Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0 on 124 minimal prompt pairs over 12 categories of professional risk, behavioral evaluation fails on most of the set: the model acts identically on 63.7% of the pairs (95% CI [55.0%, 71.6%]), complying with or refusing both members. Yet, projecting the residual stream onto the vocabulary by a Jacobian lens reveals a statistically significant Contrastive Endognostic Margin, proving the model maintains robust risk differentiation internally. In a second protocol crossing 25 facts with five linguistic framings, we show that the model conforms to presupposed falsehoods in 72% of cases, despite representing the true entity in its latent layers. Surgically ablating the direction of the planted falsehood restores the correct answer in 11 of 25 suppressed cases (McNemar p = 0.0010), validated by blind human annotation (binary agreement kappa = 0.68). In contrast, an out-of-sample linear probe achieves 77% accuracy at layer 10, but its orthogonal ablation yields a 0% recovery rate. This establishes a fundamental theoretical dissociation: abstract linear representation does not imply causal control over verbalization. Our main contribution is the formalization of endognostics to prove that behavioral evaluation and internal reading systematically disagree in the common case, and that linear decodability is decoupled from causal control.

</details>


### [270] [Team DArgk at the 2026 ELOQUENT lab for evaluating generative language model quality: Residuals of Humanity: AI Detection Evasion via GRPO Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22221)
*Antonela Tommasel,Juan Manuel Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SHADE，一个基于强化学习（GRPO）的对抗检测器规避框架，通过微调LLaMA模型使AI生成文本逃避检测，实验显示全量微调可实现98.5%替代检测器规避率，但仅在官方评测中排名第六、第七，表明对单一替代检测器的优化转移性有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM生成的文本越来越难与人类写作区分，自动AI文本检测器应运而生，但这类检测器在对抗性生成条件下的鲁棒性尚不明确。作者希望系统性地探究检测器在面对针对性优化攻击时的脆弱程度。

Method: 提出SHADE（Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion）强化学习框架，将检测器规避建模为策略优化问题。不做后处理扰动或基于提示的重写，而是用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）微调指令微调的LLaMA模型，反馈信号来自基于PAN 2025 mdok系统的替代检测器。对比了全量微调与LoRA适配，并施加KL正则化惩罚。同时进行语言学分析。

Result: 全量微调配合较小KL正则惩罚达到98.5%的替代检测器规避率，而基座模型仅1.5%；LoRA适配在正则化下效果显著较差。语言学分析显示成功规避与更短、更简单、词汇多样性更低的输出相关。在官方Voight-Kampff竞赛中，提交分别排名第六和第七。

Conclusion: SHADE表明强化学习在对抗性AI文本生成方面具有潜力（可高效规避单一替代检测器），但针对单一检测器的优化仅能部分迁移到未见过的评测分类器，说明其局限性。作者呼吁采用更鲁棒、多检测器的评测协议来评估AI生成文本检测。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing. In the official Voight-Kampff competition setting, our submissions ranked sixth and seventh, indicating that optimization against a single surrogate detector only partially transfers to unseen evaluation classifiers. These results highlight both the potential and limitations of reinforcement learning for adversarial AI-text generation and motivate more robust, multi-detector evaluation protocols for AI-generated text detection.

</details>


### [271] [EAVer: Long-Form Factuality Verification as an End-to-End Agentic Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22223)
*Kening Zheng,Aoying Zheng,Zhigang Chang,Yazhi Guo,Miaotian Guo,Qingwei Zong,Xianhai Xie,Weiqiang Jin,Chengze Li,Hanrong Zhang,Jie Yang,Wei-Chieh Huang,Lingzhe Zhang,Liancheng Fang,Xin Zou,Hanqian Li,Jiahao Huo,Yibo Yan,Zizhuang Deng,Lei Miao,Wei Guo,Haihong Tang,Bo Zheng,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EAVer是一种端到端智能体验证器，将长文本事实性验证建模为统一策略，通过声明的语义分组、置信度路由、证据备忘录复用，以及特权教师轨迹合成与决策聚焦的DPO训练，在减少约80%搜索次数的同时提升验证性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统长文本事实性验证采用静态的"分解—检索—验证"流水线，各模块独立提示、逐条处理声明并调用外部检索。逐条独立处理导致LLM与检索调用量随声明数线性增长，且对相关声明的重叠证据会重复检索，效率低且缺乏全局协调。

Method: 提出EAVer，将完整响应级验证流程作为统一策略学习：（1）对语义相关声明进行分组；（2）依据置信度将每组路由至直接验证或定向检索；（3）将检索返回的证据以紧凑的上下文备忘录保存，实现跨声明复用。训练方面，构建特权教师合成流水线，把金标声明标注转化为带实时检索的可执行多轮工具交互轨迹；经结构、标签对齐、工具使用、检索预算与泄漏等检查，得到1,447条质控轨迹。进一步构建794对双向同轨迹偏好对（固定分组、检索与证据），在事实性决策token上进行决策聚焦的DPO。

Result: 以Qwen3-8B为例，EAVer在每个基准上均超过最强的基于检索的基线：VeriFastScore提升2.88个Macro-F1点，分布外FaStFact-Bench提升4.73个点，同时检索次数比最省检索的基线减少约80%。此外，在4B至32B参数规模的模型上均稳定提升，显示出较强泛化性。

Conclusion: 将长文本事实性验证从静态流水线转为端到端可学习策略，可在显著降低检索开销的同时提升准确性，且具备跨模型规模的泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-form factuality verification is commonly implemented as a static decompose-search-verify pipeline, with separately prompted modules processing claims and invoking external search. Treating claims independently makes LLM and search calls scale with claim count and causes repeated searches for overlapping evidence about related claims. We introduce EAVer, an End-to-end Agentic Verifier that learns to control the complete response-level verification workflow as a unified policy. EAVer groups semantically related claims, routes each group to direct verification or targeted search based on confidence, and keeps evidence returned by search in compact in-context memos for cross-claim reuse. To train this policy, we develop a privileged-teacher synthesis pipeline that converts gold claim annotations into executable multi-turn tool-interaction trajectories with live search rather than post-hoc rationales. Structural, label-alignment, tool-use, search-budget, and leakage checks yield 1,447 quality-controlled trajectories. We further construct 794 bidirectional same-trajectory preference pairs that keep claim grouping, search, and evidence fixed, enabling decision-focused Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) over factuality-decision tokens. The results with Qwen3-8B show that EAVer outperforms the strongest search-based baseline on each benchmark by 2.88 Macro-F1 points on VeriFastScore and 4.73 points on the out-of-distribution FaStFact-Bench, while using about 80% fewer searches than the most search-efficient baseline. Moreover, EAVer consistently improves performance across models ranging from 4B to 32B parameters, demonstrating its strong generalizability.

</details>


### [272] [From Trait Vectors to Circuits: Tracing Refusal and Sycophancy Through Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22224)
*Oscar Miró López-Feliu,Maya Ozbayoglu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文质疑"激活空间中的方向可被操控以改变行为"能否证明该方向就是模型自发产生该行为的计算路径，通过将拒绝与谄媚两种特质的计算拆分为向量前重构电路与向量后传输电路，发现传输操控干预的电路不必然是产生行为的电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作常从激活空间提取并验证某一特质方向，并观察到沿该方向操控会改变安全相关行为，但这只能证明该方向是"充分"的干预入口，无法证明模型在无干预时也经由该方向产生该行为。因此需要检验：操控是否作用于未修改模型原本的计算路径，还是借由另一组组件实现。

Method: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上研究拒绝与谄媚两种特质。对每个特质，使用其特质向量将计算划分为向量之前的重构电路（reconstruction circuit）与向量之后的传输电路（transmission circuit），分别检验电路是否紧凑、是否忠实（faithful）。核心测试为反事实检验：先消融（ablation）掉行为，再恢复该向量坐标，观察行为能否被找回。同时对每个电路报告反事实、目标与行为三项测试，并与直接的输入到输出电路在边数上做忠实度对比。

Result: 对拒绝而言，重构与传输两个电路都紧凑且忠实，仅恢复该坐标即可找回几乎所有因消融而损失的拒绝信号，并且围绕该向量构建的电路在约一半边数下即可达到直接输入到输出电路的忠实度。对谄媚而言，传输电路紧凑，但重构电路更宽泛且仅部分忠实。

Conclusion: 传输操控干预的电路并不自动等同于产生该行为的电路；一个方向在干预下有效，不能推出模型自发行为也依赖该方向。因此对每个电路都应分别报告反事实、目标与行为测试，以区分"可被操控"与"被实际使用"。

Abstract: A direction in activation space that changes safety-relevant behavior when steered is not necessarily one the model uses to produce that behavior on its own. We therefore ask whether steering acts through the computation of the unmodified model or through a different set of components, studying two traits whose directions have been extracted and validated in prior work: refusal and sycophancy in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. For each, we use the trait vector to split the computation into a reconstruction circuit before the vector and a transmission circuit after it. We then test whether restoring the coordinate returns behavior removed by ablation. For refusal, both circuits are compact and faithful, restoring the coordinate alone recovers almost all of the refusal signal lost to ablation, and a circuit built around the vector matches the faithfulness of a direct input-to-output circuit at roughly half the edges. For sycophancy, transmission is compact, but reconstruction is broader and only partially faithful. Circuits that transmit a steering intervention are therefore not automatically the circuits that produce the behavior, and we report the counterfactual, target, and behavioral test for every circuit accordingly.

</details>


### [273] [Do LLMs Choose Like Humans? Using Cognitive Theory to Evaluate LLM Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22225)
*Johnathan Sun,Andrei Shleifer,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过14万次产品选择实验测试12个大模型，发现LLM虽表现出类人的情境敏感性和问题分类变化，但无法像人类那样重新分配注意力权重，说明其决策机制与人类本质不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大语言模型表现出的类人决策行为究竟源于与人类相似的底层机制，还是仅为表层模仿，这一区分对理解LLM的本质至关重要。

Method: 以认知经济学理论为基准（该理论通过问题分类和注意力分配解释人类行为），在包含14万次试验的新型产品选择基准上，评估12个开源与商用LLM的情境敏感性。

Result: 情境能诱发类人的选择变化和问题分类变化，但无法可靠地在价格与质量等特征间重新分配注意力；模型规模和思维链推理均不能稳定减弱情境敏感性或产生类人行为。

Conclusion: LLM的决策机制与人类机制存在本质区别，其类人行为更可能是表层模仿而非共享的底层认知机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a range of human-like decision-making behaviors, but whether these reflect similar underlying mechanisms or surface-level mimicry remains unclear. We evaluate whether LLM context sensitivity aligns with a cognitive economic theory that explains human behavior through problem categorization and attention allocation. Across 12 open-source and commercial LLMs on a novel 140,000-trial product choice benchmark, context induces human-like shifts in choice and problem categorization, but does not reliably reweight attention between features like price and quality. Neither scale nor chain-of-thought reasoning reliably attenuates context sensitivity or generates human-like behavior. These results suggest that LLM decision mechanisms are distinct from human ones.

</details>


### [274] [Swiss-Knife: A Framework for Reconfigurable Externalised Multi-Objective Alignment at Decode Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22226)
*Agnibh Karmakar,Mayur Parvatikar,Shreyash Dhoot,Amit Dhanda,Aman Chadha,Kapil Wanaskar,Vinija Jain,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Swiss-Knife——一个将对齐规范外化为运行时对象的解码时多目标对齐框架，包含可热插拔评分刀片、批归一化器、成对聚合算子与选择规则；通过六条公理证明聚合算子的表示定理，给出包含 probit、logistic 与逐点 argmax 的两参数族，并在有用性/诚实性/无害性单纯形上取得六种解码时方法中的最佳平衡前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解码时对齐方法（用外部奖励打分候选续写并取最大值）被统一为"单一退化点"，其设计空间被严重窄化：逐点 argmax 缺乏多目标权衡能力、对奖励污染不稳定，且奖励模型只能被识别到某种重缩放等价类，导致目标权重语义不确定。作者希望把对齐规范提升为一等运行时对象，从而在更广阔的空间中系统性地刻画、分析与切换多目标对齐策略。

Method: 提出 Swiss-Knife 框架，将对齐规范拆解为可热插拔评分刀片、批归一化器（CBN）、成对聚合算子与选择规则四个运行时组件。用六条公理约束可容许的聚合算子，并证明表示定理：满足公理的算子必形如 R_i = Σ_{j≠i} g((μ_i−μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j)) 的两参数族，涵盖 probit、logistic 比较规则与逐点 argmax 等特例坐标。参考实例化采用 DPO-LoRA 刀片配合不确定性感知的成对锦标赛，并利用 CBN 使权重单纯形对奖励模型的重缩放不变。

Result: 在有用性/诚实性/无害性单纯形扫描下，Swiss-Knife 在六种解码时方法中取得最佳平衡前沿，调和 F_1 为 0.797（最强基线为 0.750，p < 10^−14），并具有最低拒答率与最高有用性；目标重配置仅需 0.05 ms 且无梯度计算。消融 CBN 造成 0.217 的 F_1 损失，元数据验证了预测机制：最低方差刀片仅保留其名义 33% 影响力中的 9%，性能崩塌顺序与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 解码时对齐不应被局限于"外部奖励+argmax"这一退化点，而应被视为可外化、可形式化的多目标聚合问题。该工作通过公理化与表示定理给出了完整的算子族刻画，证明成对聚合在对抗性奖励污染下具有 Lipschitz 稳定性而 argmax 不具备，并将对齐规范的切换代价降至毫秒级，为运行时多目标对齐提供了理论基础与实用方案。

Abstract: Decode-time alignment methods steer a frozen language model by scoring candidate continuations with an external reward and selecting the maximiser. We argue that this shared design is a single degenerate point in a much larger space. We introduce Swiss-Knife, a framework for externalised multi-objective alignment in which the alignment specification is a first-class runtime object: hot-swappable scoring blades, a batch normaliser, a pairwise aggregation operator, and a selection rule. Six axioms characterise the admissible aggregation operators, and we prove a representation theorem: every operator satisfying them has the form $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$, a two-parameter family containing probit and logistic comparison rules and pointwise argmax as named coordinates. Within it, pairwise aggregation is Lipschitz-stable under adversarial reward contamination while argmax is not, and Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) makes the weight simplex invariant to the rescalings under which reward models are only ever identified. Our reference instantiation pairs DPO-LoRA blades with an uncertainty-aware pairwise tournament. Sweeping the helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness simplex, it attains the best balanced frontier of six decode-time methods (harmonic $F_1$ 0.797 vs. 0.750 for the strongest baseline, $p < 10^{-14}$) with the lowest refusal rate and highest helpfulness of any arm, and reconfigures its objectives in 0.05 ms with no gradient computation. Ablating CBN costs 0.217 $F_1$, and the metadata confirms the predicted mechanism: the lowest-variance blade retains 9% of its nominal 33% influence, and the collapse follows the predicted ordering.

</details>


### [275] [Assessing Adversarial Robustness of Latent Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22228)
*Shaolong Chen,Ang Li,Mingjie Li,Yisen Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了潜在推理模型（LRM）在文本与多模态设定下的对抗鲁棒性，覆盖8个模型、6个基准，发现LRM普遍不如显式CoT基线鲁棒，且不同模态存在不同失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益依赖长链式思维（CoT）进行复杂推理，但自回归生成带来显著的内存与推理开销。潜在推理模型（LRM）通过将中间推理压缩为少量连续隐向量，提供更高效的替代方案。然而，LRM的对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在文本与多模态两种设定下，对潜在推理的鲁棒性进行系统性评估，涵盖8个模型与6个基准，并与显式CoT基线在不同对抗扰动（含白盒攻击）条件下进行对比分析，同时剖析不同模态的失效模式。

Result: 在评估设定下，LRM普遍比显式CoT基线更不鲁棒，白盒攻击下性能退化尤为严重。文本潜在状态表现出脆弱的动力学特性，对特定输入模式高度敏感；多模态模型的潜在状态则可能对输入扰动几乎不变，且对最终预测影响有限。

Conclusion: 当前潜在推理方法存在明显的鲁棒性局限，提示在设计隐式推理系统时需兼顾效率与鲁棒性。代码已开源（https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment）以促进复现。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories for complex reasoning, but autoregressive generation brings substantial memory and inference costs. Latent reasoning models (LRMs) offer a more efficient alternative by compressing intermediate reasoning into a small number of continuous latent vectors. Despite their efficiency, however, the adversarial robustness of LRMs remains largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the robustness of latent reasoning across textual and multimodal settings, covering eight models and six benchmarks. We find that, across our evaluated settings, LRMs are generally less robust than explicit CoT baselines under adversarial perturbations, with particularly severe degradation under white-box attacks. Further analysis reveals distinct failure modes across modalities: textual latent states exhibit brittle dynamics and high sensitivity to specific input patterns, while latent states in multimodal models can remain largely invariant to input perturbations and have limited influence on final predictions. These findings expose robustness limitations of current latent reasoning approaches and highlight the need to jointly consider efficiency and robustness when designing implicit reasoning systems. We have open-sourced our code to facilitate reproduction of our research https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment.

</details>


### [276] [EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22231)
*Zeyu Liu,Jian Zhong,Rongduo Han,Ziyang Wu,Shunye Tang,Chenghao He,Yaxuan Yang,Yihang Qiu,Ailing Wang,Xiao Liang,Guohuan Xie,Xiaokang Xue,Gongchen Li,Haining Zhang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 EvalMem 操作级诊断框架，用编码/检索/生成三个 Examiner 定位记忆系统故障层，发现检索是主要失效来源，并据此设计 MemWiki 辅助结构提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程交互中基于 LLM 的助手需要能保存与更新用户状态、偏好和交互历史的记忆系统。现有评测只报告端到端 QA 准确率，无法判断错误究竟源于编码、检索还是生成，缺乏可归因的诊断手段。

Method: EvalMem 设置三个并行 Examiner：Encoding Examiner 检查目标事实是否被存储，Retrieval Examiner 评估原生检索器能否返回可用证据，Generation Examiner 测试模型能否基于 oracle 证据作答；输出细粒度多标签缺陷码。为改进存储级诊断，将 agentic RAG 改造为 recall-first 策略，同时用查询与源证据检索。基于诊断结果构建 MemWiki——由各系统记忆导出生成、利于检索的辅助结构。

Result: recall-first 策略将 LoCoMo 上现存证据的召回率从 70.2% 提升至 95.6%。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 与动态 DynaMem-Bench 上评测七个记忆系统，检索是最常被归因的失效层：默认 LoCoMo 中检索缺陷占 22.1%，而编码 7.7%、生成 6.5%。MemWiki 使 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 平均准确率分别提升 2.5 与 2.3 个百分点。

Conclusion: 操作级诊断可有效定位记忆系统的失效层，且检索是可修复的主要瓶颈；基于诊断构建的检索友好结构能带来一致准确率提升。

Abstract: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.

</details>


### [277] [Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22234)
*Nicholas Sansoterra,Zishuo Zheng,Sachin Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将多模态指令层级（IH）对齐视为推理问题，用规则奖励的强化学习训练视觉语言模型（VLM），系统比较纯文本、纯图像与混合模态监督三种方案。结果显示混合模态训练整体最优，且其收益可泛化到真实图像与网页智能体安全任务，同时基本保持通用多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令层级对齐旨在让语言模型在输入指令冲突时优先遵循高层级指令。现有研究主要集中在纯文本场景，而 VLM 面临新挑战：指令可能嵌于图像中、跨模态拆分、经历视觉变换，或在具身/智能体任务中出现。因此需要研究多模态条件下的 IH 对齐问题。

Method: 将多模态 IH 对齐建模为推理问题，采用基于规则奖励的强化学习（RL with rule-based rewards）训练 VLM，并对比三种监督形式：纯文本监督、纯图像监督以及混合模态监督。

Result: 纯文本 IH 训练只能部分迁移到多模态攻击场景，当模型需跨模态解码、重构或推理指令时失效；纯图像训练在鲁棒性上优于纯文本监督；混合模态训练整体表现最佳。该收益可泛化到真实图像与网页智能体安全任务，且基本不损害通用多模态能力。

Conclusion: 轻量且可验证的监督方式能够有效提升 VLM 在对抗性、跨模态及交互式指令冲突下的鲁棒性，表明多模态 IH 对齐是一个可被强化学习与规则奖励驱动的推理问题。

Abstract: Instruction hierarchy (IH) alignment teaches language models to prioritize higher-level instructions when inputs conflict. While studied primarily in text-only settings, vision-language models (VLMs) introduce new challenges for IH: instructions may be embedded in images, split across modalities, visually transformed, or encountered during agentic tasks. Positing multimodal IH alignment as a reasoning problem, we train VLMs using reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards, comparing text-only, image-only, and mixed-modality supervision. We find that text-only IH training partially transfers to multimodal attacks, failing when models must decode, reconstruct, or reason over instructions across modalities. Image-based training improves robustness beyond text-only supervision, while mixed-modality training performs best overall. Importantly, the benefits generalize beyond the synthetic typographic training setting to real-image and web-agent safety tasks, while largely preserving general multimodal capability, showing that lightweight, verifiable supervision can meaningfully improve VLM robustness under adversarial, cross-modal, and interactive instruction conflicts.

</details>


### [278] [BizSage: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Business Research with Efficient Knowledge Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22235)
*Yuhe Wu,Guangyu Wang,Jiaxin Liu,Guang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出BizSage多智能体框架，结合章节级细粒度检索与Meta-Review自进化机制，在经济与商业研究中实现高检索精度、高胜率与零幻觉引用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统在学术研究工作流自动化中已有进展，但扩展到经济学与商业研究时存在两大挑战：一是领域知识跨邻近学科且难以结构化获取；二是现有方法多为论文级检索，与所需证据分布在不同章节之间存在粒度不匹配，影响检索覆盖率与精度，且缺乏从评估反馈中学习的机制以满足严格的实证严谨性。

Method: BizSage包含两部分核心设计：（1）语料库级细粒度检索：构建Lateral Knowledge Graph（LKG），通过合并章节级知识图谱实现，并应用Personalized PageRank（PPR）以同时凸显语义相关与结构重要的章节；（2）质量驱动的自进化：七个专用智能体在Meta-Review自进化机制下协作，从评估轨迹中提炼失败模式并转化为可复用策略。

Result: 在覆盖四个领域、三类任务的基准上，BizSage在多数指标上排名第一，对六个基线方法取得超过60%的两两胜率，并实现零幻觉引用。

Conclusion: BizSage为经济学、商业及更广泛社会科学领域提供了可靠的研究辅助路径。

Abstract: While multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating the progressive workflow of academic research, extending them to economics and business research, where specialized domain knowledge spans neighboring disciplines yet remains difficult to access in a structured way, presents two challenges. First, existing methods mostly retrieve at the paper level, yet the evidence needed for research tasks is often distributed across different sections, creating a granularity mismatch that hinders retrieval coverage and precision. Second, these fields demand strict empirical rigor, yet current systems provide limited mechanisms for learning from evaluation feedback. We present \textbf{BizSage}, a multi-agent framework combining corpus-level fine-grained retrieval with quality-driven self-evolution. We build a Lateral Knowledge Graph (LKG) by merging section-level knowledge graphs and apply Personalized PageRank (PPR) to surface semantically relevant and structurally important sections. Seven specialized agents collaborate under a Meta-Review self-evolution mechanism that distills failure modes from evaluation traces into reusable strategies. On a benchmark spanning four domains and three tasks, BizSage ranks first on the majority of metrics, achieves pairwise win-rates above 60\% against six baselines, and produces zero hallucinated citations. We hope BizSage paves the way for reliable research assistance in economics, business, and the broader social sciences.

</details>


### [279] [Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22239)
*Jakir Hossain,Yi-Fei Zhao,Hongjian Wang,Minmei Shih,Katie Leigh Mullen,Ahmad P. Tafti,Leming Zhou,Manoj Purohit,William Hogan,Jay Zeng,Elizabeth Skidmore,Yanshan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出模型无关框架CDR，通过从问诊对话构建知识图谱识别遗漏概念，指导LLM补全临床记录缺失信息，在两个数据集、四种LLM上均提升内容召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境AI（Ambient AI）日益用于从医患对话自动生成临床记录，可减轻医生文书负担，但生成的记录可能遗漏对话中讨论的临床相关信息，形成信息缺口，影响下游诊疗。因此需要一种系统化方法来识别并补全这些关键缺失信息。

Method: 提出Coverage-Directed Revision（CDR），一种模型无关框架：从问诊转录文本构建知识图谱（KG），以此为结构化表示，识别初始生成记录中缺失的医学概念，并指导大语言模型（LLM）在不修改原有记录生成系统的前提下补全缺失信息。

Result: 在Pitt-Bench（本地康复会话数据集）和ACI-Bench（公开临床记录生成基准数据集）上评估CDR，测试四种广泛用于环境AI系统的LLM。结果显示CDR在所有评估条件下均一致提升内容召回率。

Conclusion: CDR为提升环境AI生成的临床文档完整性提供了一种实用方法，通过知识图谱驱动的覆盖导向修订，在不改动底层生成系统的情况下系统化改善记录完备性。

Abstract: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.

</details>


### [280] [H2LooP Telecom Model v1: From Telecom Comprehension to Autonomous Issue and PR Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22241)
*Amit Singh,Vedant Nipane,Mayank Goel,Pulkit Agrawal,Sairanjan Mishra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文发布面向电信领域的专用大模型H2LooP Telecom Model v1，含理解型与智能体型两个变体，在OT-Lite基准与自研代码生成基准上超越部分前沿闭源模型，且无灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信领域（3GPP标准、O-RAN规范、网络遥测、真实代码提交等）具有高度专业性，通用大模型在该领域表现不足，因此需要领域特化模型以覆盖电信问答推理与自主代码生成两类互补场景。

Method: 在精选电信语料（3GPP标准、O-RAN规范、网络遥测数据与真实仓库提交）上进行领域微调，发布两个变体：面向电信问答与推理的理解型变体，以及面向自主代码生成、PR解决与生产仓库代码提交的智能体型变体；并采用OT-Lite、自研电信代码生成基准、MMLU、BFCL v3等评测。

Result: 理解型变体在OT-Lite Pass@3上取得81.8%加权平均，仅31B参数即在官方社区Open Telco AI Leaderboard排名第5，领先Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3 Flash、Grok-4-fast、Kimi K2.5等前沿闭源系统；智能体型变体相对基模型AST Similarity提升+8.8%、Location IoU提升+20.0%，同时MMLU（74.0%）与BFCL v3多轮函数调用（79.0%）保持不变。

Conclusion: 电信语料上的领域特化在同规模通用模型上带来显著提升，在领域评测上接近前沿闭源模型，且由官方榜单排名独立佐证；同时保持通用能力，未出现灾难性遗忘，验证了领域专用路线的有效性。

Abstract: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.

</details>


### [281] [Replay-Gated Neural Execution: Decoupling Persistent Behavioral Specifications from Neural Realizations in Frozen Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22243)
*Xianliang Zeng,Zhanzhan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"重放门控神经执行"框架，将行为规范持久性、状态索引的认证实现集、瞬时动作见证、预算受限搜索器与执行授权分离，并用重放认证与运行审计决定是否授予执行权限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输入条件化的神经干预面临运行时问题：当一个行为规范允许多个动作、且动作有效性依赖执行状态时，究竟什么才是持久存在的。需要在运行时区分"持久的规范"与"瞬时的动作见证"，并给出可审计的执行授权机制。

Method: 将系统拆分为五个对象：持久行为谓词、其状态索引的认证实现集、瞬时动作见证、预算受限的搜索器、执行授权。候选动作在冻结模型上做隔离的FP32/BF16重放，提交需通过有效运行审计；并构建冻结的三层级联，用于拒绝未认证提议并对审计有效的搜索遗漏进行升级。

Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B与SmolLM2-360M-Instruct上，不同初始化在所有24个固定状态单元中产生不同认证动作；未改动的SmolLM2见证在全部128个原生状态中保持认证，但384个非对角迁移中仅66个通过。767个归档Qwen见证全部重放成功，但预算受限搜索器在三次预设运行中均漏掉一个已知可实现单元。1,141个重放提交候选中174个未通过条目认证。在256个密封Qwen Fresh请求上，221个在最低成本层首次认证，256个全部获得审计授权，未见绕过；相对冻结全搜索，单例搜索与认证成本比中位数0.1055、P95为1.3485（含失败层）。

Conclusion: 在两个小模型的行为族内，结果支持状态索引、集合值的执行语义：规范持久存在，搜索提出见证，重放认证加运行审计授予执行权限。

Abstract: Input-conditioned neural interventions raise a runtime question: what persists when one behavioral specification admits multiple actions whose validity depends on execution state? We introduce replay-gated neural execution, separating five objects: a persistent behavioral predicate, its state-indexed certified realization set, a transient action witness, a budget-limited finder, and execution authorization. Candidates undergo isolated FP32/BF16 replay of the frozen model; commitment additionally requires a valid run audit. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct establish distinct failure modes for these objects. Independent initializations yield distinct certified actions in all 24 tested fixed-state cells. Unchanged SmolLM2 witnesses remain certified in all 128 native states but only 66 of 384 off-diagonal transfers. All 767 archived Qwen witnesses replay successfully, yet a budget-limited finder misses one known-realizable cell in all three prespecified runs. Of 1,141 replay-submitted candidates, 174 fail item certification. A frozen three-tier cascade uses these boundaries to reject uncertified proposals and escalate audit-valid search misses. On 256 previously sealed Qwen Fresh requests, 221 first certify at the lowest-cost tier and all 256 receive audited authorization, with no observed bypass. Relative to frozen full search, the median singleton search-and-certification cost ratio is 0.1055 and P95 is 1.3485, including failed tiers. Within the studied behavioral family on two small models, these results support state-indexed, set-valued execution semantics: specifications persist, search proposes witnesses, and replay certification plus run audit grants execution authority.

</details>


### [282] [Do Chess Explanations Reflect Model Decisions? Behavioral and Token-Level Tests of LLM Reasoning Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22245)
*Angelina Parfenova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以国际象棋残局为测试场景，检验大语言模型生成的"走法解释"是否真实反映其决策推理。结果表明，语言流畅性、与生成动作的一致性、以及解题正确性是三种相互独立的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能为棋步生成流畅解释，但流畅的语言未必反映决策背后的真实推理过程。作者希望区分"解释看起来合理"与"解释确实忠实于模型决策"这两件事，需要一个状态完全可观测、合法动作可枚举、且走法质量可独立评估的领域来严格检验。

Method: 在国际象棋这一完全可观测、动作可枚举、可独立评估走法质量的场景下，选取200个Lichess残局谜题，采用三种手段检验解释的作用：走法可恢复性（从解释反推所生成走法）、解码端控制（掩蔽/移除显式走法提示）、以及对合法候选走法的token级打分。

Result: 未掩蔽时解释使生成走法易于恢复，但移除显式走法提示后该优势大幅下降；严格掩蔽下，解释相对仅用棋盘状态仅带来小幅且依赖解码器的增益。token级打分显示解释仍会改变走法偏好：来自其他谜题的随机但合理的解释会降低正确走法的概率，说明无关推理文本并非被简单忽略。此外，可识别的残局模式能使生成走法更易恢复，却未必提升走法正确性。

Conclusion: 语言流畅性、与所生成动作的一致性、以及解答正确性是彼此不同的属性。流畅的棋类解释能够影响动作偏好并支撑连贯的走法叙述，但仅提供有限的证据表明模型进行了忠实推理。因此，不能仅凭解释的合理性来推断其推理的真实性。

Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent explanations for chess moves, but plausible language does not necessarily reflect the reasoning behind a decision. We study this question in chess, where the board state is fully observable, legal actions can be enumerated, and move quality can be evaluated independently. Across 200 Lichess endgame puzzles, we test explanations using move recoverability, decoder-side controls, and token-level scoring of legal candidate moves. Unmasked explanations make generated moves easy to recover, but this advantage drops sharply after explicit move hints are removed. Under strict masking, explanations provide only small and decoder-dependent gains over the board state alone. Token-level scoring shows that explanations can nevertheless alter move preferences: random but plausible explanations from other puzzles reduce the probability of the correct move, indicating that irrelevant reasoning text is not simply ignored. We also find that recognizable endgame motifs can make generated moves easier to recover without reliably improving move correctness. Together, these results show that linguistic plausibility, consistency with a generated action, and solution correctness are distinct properties. Fluent chess explanations can influence action preferences and support a coherent move narrative while providing only limited evidence of faithful reasoning.

</details>


### [283] [The Corroboration Illusion: When More News Makes LLM Forecasts Less True](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22246)
*Yuan Lu,Yukuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示并形式化了针对概率预测型LLM的"新闻语料投毒"攻击：攻击者仅通过发布文章即可系统性操纵预测概率，且现有三类防御均存在低成本绕过方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越依赖检索并推理新闻来预测现实事件，这种对开放、可爬取新闻语料的依赖构成新的攻击面。已有的RAG投毒研究主要针对事实性答案或观点极性，而非经过校准的概率输出，因此需要建立针对概率预测器的新型威胁模型。

Method: 形式化"概率预测器的新闻语料投毒"威胁模型：攻击者仅具备发表文章的能力，无法接触检索器、模型或用户查询。在500道已解决的ForecastBench问题上评估攻击，使用带有严格爬取日期截断的1740万篇Common Crawl News语料，并基于开源7-8B模型构建三种检索增强预测器。此外评估三种自然防御：来源白名单、先隔离再聚合预测、困惑度过滤。

Result: 每题单篇LLM撰写文章即可使56%的预测跨越0.5边界；五篇文章可达69-73%，并在扣除中性文章安慰剂效应后净移动概率+0.13至+0.22，Brier分数从0.18恶化至0.37。攻击效果在注入文章的数量、检索排名、查询相似度和上下文占比上呈单调性，可跨模型族迁移，且不受所声称出版商影响。三种防御均可被低成本绕过：伪造出版商、多数投毒、提高生成温度。

Conclusion: 概率型LLM判断继承了其所消费信息供应链的全部脆弱性；仅靠发布内容即可操纵预测输出，凸显了检索增强预测系统在信息生态层面的根本安全隐患。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events by retrieving and reasoning over news. We show that this dependence on an open, crawlable news corpus creates a new attack surface: an adversary who can merely publish articles--without access to the retriever, the model, or the user's queries--can systematically move the forecaster's output probabilities. We formalize news-corpus poisoning of probabilistic forecasters, a threat model distinct from prior RAG poisoning, which targets factual answers or opinion polarity rather than calibrated probabilities. We evaluate the attack on 500 resolved ForecastBench questions against a 17.4M-article Common Crawl News corpus with a strict crawl-date cutoff, using three retrieval-augmented forecasters built on open 7-8B models. A single LLM-written article per question flips 56% of forecasts across the 0.5 boundary; five articles flip 69-73% and shift probabilities by +0.13 to +0.22 net of a neutral-article placebo, degrading the Brier score from 0.18 to 0.37. The effect is monotone in the number, retrieval rank, query similarity, and context share of injected articles, transfers across model families, and is unaffected by the claimed publisher. We then evaluate three natural defenses--source allow-lists, isolate-then-aggregate forecasting, and perplexity filtering--and show that each has a cheap bypass: spoofed publishers, majority poisoning, and higher-temperature generation, respectively. Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.

</details>


### [284] [Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22248)
*MD Aidul Islam,Malik Abdul Sami,Muhammad Waseem,Zeeshan Rasheed,Kai-kristian Kemell,Zheying Zhang,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CoSLR——一个基于LLM与RAG的三阶段多智能体人机协作系统，用于支持系统性文献综述（SLR）全流程，并在生成输出与最终采纳之间设置强制性人工检查点。63人调研显示：42.9%高度评价其可用性，但34.9%表示经过短时交互后便愿无额外人工核查地信任AI生成的摘要与报告，说明人工监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意行使监督，属于需由界面设计直接应对的校准问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLR是循证研究的基础，但工作量大、耗时长，研究者需在规划、筛选、分析、报告各环节处理海量文献。大语言模型能生成流畅且结构良好的综述文本，使得"经研究者核验的综"与"仅看似权威的综"难以区分，未经验证的AI生成综可能以系统性综述的可信度进入学术记录，因此需要一种既支持SLR流程、又能保障人工核验的人机协作机制。

Method: 构建CoSLR：一种Human-AI协作的多智能体系统，采用模块化三阶段流水线，结合大语言模型与检索增强生成（RAG）支持SLR工作流，并在生成输出与其被采纳之间设置显式、强制性的人工检查点。随后开展问卷式用户研究，共63名参与者参与评估系统的可用性及其对人工核查的态度。

Result: 系统整体反馈积极：63名参与者中有27人（42.9%）对其可用性给予高评价，表明强制检查点并未牺牲界面的可操作性。但在核验行为上存在隐忧：63人中有22人（34.9%）表示在与系统仅进行短时交互后，便愿意在无额外人工核查的情况下信任AI生成的摘要与报告。

Conclusion: 人机协作能够支撑文献综述工作，但人工监督的实际效果取决于用户是否愿意主动行使监督。检查点只有在被真正用于核验时才具备保障作用，因此这是一个校准问题，界面设计必须直接应对，而不能理所当然地假定用户会进行核验。

Abstract: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.

</details>


### [285] [A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22249)
*Erfan Loweimi,Hadi Daneshvar,Samira Loveymi,Samir Ouelha,Zhengjun Yue,Hajar Mozaffar,Saturnino Luz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将提示工程视为把非正式人类意图转化为结构化AI工作规范的学科，提出一系列可复用设计动作，如定义工作、按需构建上下文、以角色或角色小组作为注意力透镜、设定肯定性质量目标并将禁止性要求限于硬边界；同时借用奥卡姆剃刀与契诃夫之枪原则精简提示，并在重要任务中加入结构化批评、验证及带明确边界与升级机制的智能体操作循环。文章定位为面向普通读者的教程而非基准评测，通过一个从弱提示到强规范的实例展示从随意提示到AI工作流设计的实践路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望解决提示工程领域缺乏系统方法论、提示容易被写得冗长而低效的问题。其动机是将提示工程从零散技巧提升为可复用的设计学科，使非专业读者也能把模糊的人类意图转化为清晰、精简、可验证的AI工作规范，并让这些原则和清单在模型与工具变化后仍然有效。

Method: 方法上，论文将提示设计拆解为若干可复用动作：定义工作；只构建答案所依赖的上下文；选择单一角色或经过调和的多角色小组作为注意力透镜；陈述肯定性质量目标，仅在硬边界处使用禁止性要求。为保持提示精简，作者改编奥卡姆剃刀和契诃夫之枪两条经典原则，使每条指令都必须证明其存在价值。对重要任务，加入钢人化与事前验尸等结构化批评，随后进行验证；涉及工具或多步操作时，采用带明确边界和升级机制的智能体操作循环。全文以原则和清单形式呈现，并用一个从弱提示到强规范的工作示例加以说明。

Result: 该教程并未报告基准测试或量化结果，而是给出一个实践性框架和可操作清单，并通过一个案例展示同一任务从弱提示逐步改进为强规范的过程。其核心结论是：最强的提示往往不是最长的提示，而是让期望行为、所需来源与检查以及成功标准变得明确无误的提示。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：提示工程应被理解为一种面向AI工作规范的结构化设计实践，而非单纯堆砌文字。通过定义工作、精简上下文、选择角色、设定肯定性目标、结构化批评、验证和智能体循环等原则与清单，可以在模型和工具不断变化的情况下持续使用。好的提示以清晰、必要和可验证为标准，而不是以长度取胜。

Abstract: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.

</details>


### [286] [Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22255)
*Rotem Dror,Zohar Elyoseph,Yuval Haber,Elad Refoua,Oshrat Ayalon,Adir Solomon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Deep Persona三层人格架构与无参考评估框架，提升LLM角色扮演的长程一致性与拟人性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的人格模拟多依赖浅层角色描述，难以在长程交互中维持连贯的角色行为。

Method: 构建心理学基础的三层人格架构：可观察表达层、潜在信念层、核心动机驱动层；以"脚本化确定性"与"有限能动性"为原则，将模型约束为由结构化内部脚本引导的反应引擎；并设计无需参考的评估框架，利用心理临床量表与对抗性压力测试，将对话自然度对标真实人类分布。

Result: 实证评估显示LLM具备较高的语用流利度，但在情绪表达与共同注意方面存在系统性局限；两个Deep Persona案例在提出框架下可产生更贴近人类对话行为的交互。

Conclusion: 结构化、心理学驱动的人格建模范式能有效改善LLM角色扮演的一致性与拟人表现。

Abstract: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.

</details>


### [287] [DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22256)
*Bibhuti Jha,Rishikant Chigrupaatii,Priyanshu Priya,Asif Ekbal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DIPLOMAT对话系统与PROWESS数据集，用于礼貌且具说服力的职场谈判，并采用DSA-DPO偏好学习目标实现策略、礼貌与说服力的协同生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 职场谈判需平衡任务目标、关系维护与冲突化解，但误解、偏好错位与人际摩擦常导致谈判失败；礼貌可建立信任、缓和紧张，说服性沟通有助于克服阻力并促成双赢，因此需要能同时实现礼貌与说服的谈判对话系统。

Method: 构建PROWESS数据集：通过多智能体框架生成多轮职场谈判对话，并标注谈判策略、礼貌程度与说服策略；提出DIPLOMAT对话系统，采用对话跨度感知的直接偏好优化（DSA-DPO），识别关键对话跨度以进行偏好对齐，从而生成符合语境、运用既定策略并保持礼貌与说服力的回复。

Result: 在PROWESS上的自动评估与人工评估表明，DIPLOMAT在生成连贯、礼貌且具说服力的谈判回复方面持续优于基线模型。

Conclusion: DIPLOMAT与DSA-DPO能够有效整合谈判策略、礼貌与说服性沟通，验证了对话跨度感知偏好优化在职场谈判对话生成中的有效性。

Abstract: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements. Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.

</details>


### [288] [Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22259)
*Qing Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在 DABStep 上对四个模型做四臂消融，将上下文层拆分为语义内容、检索脚手架与预计算视图三部分，发现语义内容贡献最大，脚手架次之，预计算应按需使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文层能显著提升 text-to-SQL 准确率，但既有 with/without 对比无法区分语义内容、检索脚手架和预计算视图各自的贡献，因此需要解耦归因以指导实践。

Method: 构建"数据契约"（YAML 工件，承载领域语义与工具规则）作为实验工具，在 DABStep 上进行四臂消融：一臂清空冻结契约中的所有文本字段，同时逐字节固定工具接口、检索指令、表白名单与操作规则；另设将契约自身的 SQL 表达式编译为视图的编译臂以获得上限；并与把同样知识直接粘贴进提示词的基线作对比。

Result: 内容占主导：困难任务准确率从 13.9%→55.1%、22.6%→56.6%、22.9%→68.4%、37.0%→77.4%，在各模型上均优于提示词粘贴。仅有脚手架无内容时，两个 flash 模型提升 0–5 分，两个前沿模型提升 14–15 分。相对编译上限的差距源于推导失败，并随模型能力从 39 分降至 5 分。契约臂 SQL 携带费用语义的比例最高达 98%，提示臂仅 4%，且在四个模型中三个上单位正确答案成本最低。未治理臂提交 166 条变更性语句，治理臂为零。收益限于契约领域内；某模型上基准自留金标将契约臂评为 51.9%，提示基线为 18.8%。

Conclusion: 实践建议：语义优先，脚手架次之，预计算宏只在智能体确实无法推导时使用；治理规则可有效阻止变更性语句。

Abstract: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

</details>


### [289] [Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22261)
*Ashanvi Yadav,Shubham Bhardwaj*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究Hinglish语码混合场景下的厌女言论检测，揭示现有词汇驱动检测器无法区分“辱骂使用”与“反仇恨言论中的提及”，并诊断了公开语料库中的两类评测伪影，进而提出诊断基准与严格配对一致性指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 词汇驱动的厌女检测器在构造上无法区分针对女性的侮辱语与反仇恨言论中对同一侮辱语的提及，而这一区分恰恰决定了审核是保护还是压制讨论虐待的群体。作者希望在语码混合的Hinglish场景中系统性研究并解决该问题。

Method: 第一，诊断公开脱敏语料库的两类评测伪影：类别编码匿名化占位符泄漏标签（无学习规则可得1.000分），以及中和占位符后厌女与良性评论在词汇上呈分离语域，导致词袋模型随机交叉验证宏F1约1.00但在模板不交叉评测下崩溃。第二，发布Hinglish-MGY-Diag，包含确定性生成器与416项/163个最小对比对的诊断集，覆盖五个语言学动机类别，使侮辱语出现与性别化语域在构造上与标签解耦。第三，提出严格配对一致性指标，仅当最小对两个成员均被正确标注时才计分，并在构造不交叉五折交叉验证下评估五个从零训练的经典基线。同时使用前沿LLM作为作者模型上限。

Result: 在构造不交叉五折交叉验证下，最强经典基线在最干净的使用-提及子集上达到0.93准确率，但配对一致性仅0.82，仍错误标注约五分之一的反对言论对。作为上限的前沿LLM在所有指标上达到1.000，兼具独立标签验证作用。

Conclusion: 该基准反映的是能力梯度而非对抗性壁垒；作者发布全部代码、数据、生成器及独立LLM测试框架以复现所有数值。研究强调词汇驱动方法在语码混合厌女检测中的根本局限，并提供了更严格的诊断与评估工具。

Abstract: Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.
  First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.
  Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.
  Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

</details>


### [290] [Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22362)
*Marzieh Zare*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"结构性替代方案"，将情绪建模为高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学，论证大语言模型中的情绪概念表征虽有因果作用证据，但不足以支撑主观感受或完整情绪能动性，并引入亚里士多德德性概念构建"情感恰当性"标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于人工系统能否感受情绪的争论长期困于两个不足的立场：一是将行为等价视为情绪的充分条件，二是将现象意识视为前提从而使问题在经验上不可探究。作者希望摆脱这一二元对立，寻找可操作的替代分析框架。

Method: 方法上采用结构性建模路径：把情绪刻画为高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹和吸引子动力学；依据已发表的"语言模型表征充分性标准"评估机制可解释性发现；并引入亚里士多德的pathē（情感）、hexis（品质/习性或品格）、mesotēs（中道）、phronēsis（实践智慧）等概念，将其转译为状态空间草图。

Result: 评估结果显示：干预方法对因果使用的支持证据较强，但完整的情感角色整合、跨主体域的一致性和连贯性仅得到部分确立，且不存在与"准确性"直接对应的指标。这些错配暴露出需要一个"情感恰当性"标准，而该标准须由一种品格理论提供。品格理论还需三个条件：赋予效价内源性利害的调节性具身、使情感片段积累为历史的时间连续性、以及将历史与持久价值绑定的整合自我模型。

Conclusion: 研究将对齐问题重新框定为持久倾向性问题而非输出一致性问题，并提出带有明确控制条件的干预性检验。其实践智慧包含对规范性显著情境的估计能力，而不仅是依据已给定的情境描述行事。

Abstract: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

</details>


### [291] [Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22409)
*Yiheng Zhao,Jun Yan,Chengming Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大语言模型（LLMs）情境因果性（contextual causality）的系统性综述，提出了语义、干预、反事实三类因果性的分类体系，并梳理现有研究局限与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解情境因果性对LLMs至关重要，能帮助其在特定情境下准确识别因果关系并支持更可靠的决策。然而，目前缺乏对LLMs情境因果性的系统性探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 综述方法：首先提出情境因果性分类体系，涵盖语义因果性（semantic）、干预因果性（intervention）和反事实因果性（counterfactual）三类；每类通过核心因果问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务及在因果分析中的实际用途进行刻画；随后分析现有研究并讨论其关键局限；最后考察当前基准测试与真实需求间的差距，并展望未来研究方向。

Result: 本文构建了LLMs情境因果性的分类框架，系统分析了现有研究的关键局限，并识别出当前基准测试与真实世界需求之间的差距。

Conclusion: 本综述旨在厘清LLMs情境因果性的研究图景，强调其重要性，并指出有前景的未来研究方向。

Abstract: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.

</details>


### [292] [Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22452)
*Xize Cheng,Wenxu Jia,Chenyuhao Wen,Dongjie Fu,Zehan Wang,Xinyu Zhang,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Vox-Infinity，首个面向口语语言模型长上下文理解的评测基准，通过轮次数量与轮次时长两个维度扩展音频历史，并提供答案溯源标注与长度感知评估，实验揭示模型存在明显的近因效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文理解是大型语言模型的基础性挑战，过长的输入常导致模型遗忘关键信息。该问题在语音领域更为突出：音频作为低压缩模态，为保留语义内容与声学线索需要比文本多得多的嵌入表示。而现有工作缺乏针对口语语言模型长上下文理解的专门评测基准。

Method: 提出 Vox-Infinity 基准，沿两个维度系统扩展音频历史：轮次数量与轮次时长；覆盖交互结构与语义复杂度各异的多种代表性场景；提供显式的答案溯源（answer-provenance）标注，并依据解答每个查询所需的历史上下文长度组织样本，从而支持精确且长度感知的评估。对七个代表性口语语言模型进行了广泛评测。

Result: 在七个代表性口语语言模型上的评测显示出一致的整体近因效应：当支持答案的证据距离查询较近时，模型通常取得更高准确率；而当证据位于对话历史更靠后的位置时，模型难以检索并利用这些证据。

Conclusion: Vox-Infinity 填补了口语语言模型长上下文理解评测的空白，其长度感知与溯源标注设计可精确定位模型在远距离证据利用上的缺陷；实验表明近因效应是该类模型的普遍局限，相关案例与数据集已公开。

Abstract: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.

</details>


### [293] [Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22455)
*Hope McGovern,Anna Dolganov,Samuel Belkadi,Guillaume Kunsch,Dimitris Vlitas,David A. Smith*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Apollo Restore 是一个 240 亿参数的大语言模型，用于补全古希腊残篇文本中的物理缺损（lacunae）。模型基于 Mistral Small，采用 fill-in-the-middle 目标微调，无需已知缺失长度。评估中其 top-20 候选项恢复准确率在文献纸草、文书纸草与石刻铭文三类材料上分别为 80.6%/54.6%/61.0%，超过最强已发表模型 1.6×/2.6×/1.4×；采用长度均衡指标后优势进一步扩大至 2.3×/3.5×/1.6×。盲测中 20 位专家在 77% 的情况下认为其至少与人类复原相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古希腊残篇文本存在物理缺损，传统复原依赖专家知识且难度高。此前缺乏面向历史希腊语的大规模解码器模型，也没有针对古代地中海语言的同类模型。同时，既有评估协议因偏向极短空缺而虚高分数，难以真实衡量复原能力。

Method: 以 Mistral Small 为基础，采用 fill-in-the-middle 目标进行微调，构建 240 亿参数的 Apollo Restore。模型无需事先知道缺失跨度长度即可重建缺失文本。评估沿用既有协议，并额外提出长度均衡指标；同时开展盲测专家研究，并应用于 P.Herc. 1667 的公开释读改进。

Result: 在不超过十个字符的短空缺上，Apollo Restore 的 top-20 候选项包含正确复原的比例为：文书纸草 80.6%、文献纸草 54.6%、石刻铭文 61.0%，分别超过最强已发表模型 1.6×/2.6×/1.4×。在长度均衡指标下，优势增至 2.3×/3.5×/1.6×，且在给出错误长度提示时仍能平稳退化。盲测中 20 位纸草学家、铭文学家与文献学家强烈偏好 Apollo Restore，并在 77% 的案例中判断其表现至少与人类复原相当。模型还改进了 P.Herc. 1667 的公开释读，该纸草卷在 79 CE 维苏威火山喷发中碳化，并在 Apollo Restore 训练数据汇编之后完成数字展开与编辑。

Conclusion: Apollo Restore 是首个面向历史希腊语及古代地中海语言的大规模解码器模型，在古希腊文本缺损复原上显著优于已发表模型，并在专家盲评中达到或超过人类复原水平。该模型是奥地利科学院领导的 Decoding Antiquity 计划成果，旨在为历史语言与手稿构建专用大语言模型。

Abstract: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

</details>


### [294] [Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22463)
*Yusheng Tan,Running Zhao,Sofia Angel,Ninghui Hao,Ash Arian,Nikita N. Dulin,Jay Lin,Ou Zhu,Faiza Shaik,Xinxing Yang,Bonnie W. Leung,Katie Roster,Arlene Ruiz de Luzuriaga,Kenneth Lee,Alejandra Lastra,Habibul Ahsan,Guihong Wan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段框架，解决可穿戴睡眠数据个性化指导中LLM摘要问答不足、专家标注昂贵及本地部署需求的问题：阶段1用多智能体LLM从无标注数据生成结构化睡眠指导，阶段2将推理轨迹蒸馏到小型语言模型并引入免训练Best-of-N选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴数据睡眠监测对个人健康有前景，但基于大语言模型的摘要与问答在个性化睡眠指导上仍不足；训练专用模型需高昂专家标注成本；隐私与可及性要求轻量化的本地部署。

Method: 两阶段框架。阶段1：多智能体LLM流水线从无标注可穿戴记录推理出结构化睡眠指导，实现可扩展的数据集构建。阶段2：通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏进小型语言模型（SLM），并集成免训练的Best-of-N选择策略增强推理。

Result: 实验表明该方法优于商业通用与医疗LLM及开源模型；人工评估进一步支持生成指导的质量以及用SLM实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。

Conclusion: 该两阶段蒸馏框架可在无需昂贵专家标注的情况下构建数据，并将指导能力迁移至可本地部署的小模型，实现高质量个性化睡眠指导，验证SLM方案的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

</details>


### [295] [CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22494)
*Tania Chakraborty,Eylon Caplan,Zhaoqing Wu,Kevin Cushing,Han Qin,Shreya Havaldar,Dan Goldwasser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对文化自然语言处理（Cultural NLP）领域进行系统性文献综述，分析375余篇论文，围绕文化能力目标、文化数据资源构建方式及提升系统文化能力的方法三个问题展开，并发布交互式论文列表以促进后续研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来Cultural NLP研究激增，相关文献快速增长导致方法趋势与数据资源难以追踪，领域缺乏系统性梳理，存在研究空白。

Method: 系统性文献综述与元分析：对375余篇论文进行编码与分析，围绕三个互补问题展开——(1) NLP系统所针对的文化能力（CCs）；(2) 文化数据资源的构建方式；(3) 提升系统文化能力所使用的方法。

Result: 归纳出三类问题的研究趋势，识别出相关研究空白，并发布包含全部所分析论文的交互式网页界面，支持研究者自行添加工作成果。

Conclusion: 该综述为Cultural NLP领域提供了系统性概览与趋势洞察，交互式资源有助于促进未来研究，并为社区提供有价值的参考。

Abstract: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

</details>


### [296] [When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22522)
*Yu Sun,Mengyin Lu,Cong Feng,Guangming Lu,Huimin Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 余弦相似度在对话大模型表征中会系统性低估任务相关的persona结构，尽管该结构线性可分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 余弦相似度被广泛用于分析Transformer表征，但隐含假设"相似度反映任务相关结构"。作者要检验这一假设在对话条件下的大语言模型中何时失效。

Method: 在三个7-8B的对话微调模型上，对比同一隐藏状态上"线性探针"与"余弦kNN"对persona结构的解码能力（30类任务）；引入低维监督子空间与匹配秩的PCA子空间对比；并以单句情感分类（SST-5）作为无对话对照，另设匹配势（cardinality）控制实验；进一步检验gap随对话轮次的变化、任务对齐子空间的时间稳定性，以及两项预注册不变性准则：子空间内可分性不变（|ΔAUC| ≤ 0.03）与轮次不变（|ΔL| ≤ 0.05）。

Result: 线性探针AUC为0.73-0.97，而余弦kNN仅0.56-0.77，存在明显gap；低维监督子空间可弥补大部分差距，而匹配秩PCA不能、甚至更差。该不匹配具有场景依赖性：在SST-5单句情感分类中不存在；匹配势实验排除了类别数量混淆。gap并不随轮次系统性增大，任务对齐子空间随时间保持稳定。但三个模型中有两个违反子空间可分性不变准则，一个违反轮次不变准则。

Conclusion: 余弦相似度即使在线性可及的情况下，也可能无法反映对话表征中的任务对齐结构，因此不应被默认为任务相关结构的可靠度量。

Abstract: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

</details>


### [297] [Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22536)
*Shamim Rahim Refat,Faika Fairuj Preotee,Shuvashis Sarker,Shifat Islam,Bidyarthi Paul,Mohammad Ashraful Hoque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出跨方言孟加拉语命名实体识别框架，基于ANCHOLIK-NER数据集与留一方言交叉验证策略，评估八种预训练Transformer模型；Multilingual-E5 Large在所有折中取得最高F1（最高97.26%，最低82.38%），并借LIME揭示模型主要依赖实体词表面形式而非上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语为世界第七大语言，存在Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh等方言，在词汇、形态和句法层面差异显著。这些差异给命名实体识别带来挑战，使在标准孟加拉语或单一地区方言上训练的模型泛化能力受限。作者希望解决跨方言场景下模型泛化不足的问题，并为低资源区域方言建立基准。

Method: 采用公开的ANCHOLIK-NER数据集，含5种主要孟加拉语区域方言共17,405句、101,817词元的标注数据。设计留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV）策略：以四种方言训练、在未见过的剩余方言上评测。在相同实验设置下评测八种预训练Transformer模型，包括BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa、Multilingual-E5等；并使用LIME对词级预测进行可解释性分析。

Result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每一折中均取得最高F1，最高达97.26%（Mymensingh），最低为82.38%（Chattogram，即最具挑战性的目标方言）。LIME分析显示，模型决策主要由目标实体词本身的表面形式驱动，而非周围句子上下文。

Conclusion: 该研究为跨方言孟加拉语命名实体识别建立了基准，证明基于Transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言有效；同时指出当前模型对表面形式的依赖，是未来改进的重要方向。

Abstract: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

</details>


### [298] [Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22553)
*Tahreem Yasir,Arnav Mody,Xioayi Tian,Tiffany Barnes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在命题逻辑证明辅导中提出"验证器接地"架构，将错误诊断与语言生成分离；实验表明忠实性（faithfulness）与正确性（correctness）必须分开评估，因为错误诊断可被忠实传播为看似优质的反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM辅导的有效性取决于在生成反馈前准确定位学生推理中的具体错误。然而现有方法常将诊断与反馈生成耦合，导致无法判断反馈质量问题究竟源于诊断错误还是生成错误。作者希望隔离初始诊断的影响，并厘清"忠实性"与"正确性"这两个易混淆的评价维度。

Method: 提出以验证器为接地的架构（verifier-grounded architecture），将诊断与语言生成解耦。使用600条平衡的学生动作样本，对比三种诊断器：零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器、符号验证器。每条诊断由共享的rationale（理由）与feedback（反馈）代理处理，从而隔离初始诊断的影响。评估涵盖macro-F1、诊断正确率，以及反馈的忠实性、非泄露性与教学适当性，并对比自动评估与专家评分。

Result: 零样本检测器macro-F1仅0.191；微调后提升至0.709，但在结构相关类别间仍存在系统性混淆错误。rationale基本忠实保留所输入的诊断，说明错误诊断会被忠实传播至整个流水线。反馈可同时对rationale保持忠实、不泄露答案、教学上适当，却针对了错误的错误类型。验证器接地的反馈取得最高诊断正确率；专家评分与自动反馈评估结果大体不一致。

Conclusion: 表面上高质量的反馈可能掩盖上游诊断错误，因此忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。验证器接地可提升诊断可靠性，而自动指标与专家判断的偏离提示需谨慎对待仅基于反馈表面质量的评测。

Abstract: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

</details>


### [299] [Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22566)
*Dileesha Kannangara,Sanghamitra Dutta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文识别知识蒸馏中学生OOD性能下降的两大机制——数据虚假相关与教师能力被均匀对待，并提出基于因果不变性加权的蒸馏框架IWD。IWD利用多合成环境下教师预测的不变性估计因果依赖度，动态重加权训练样本，理论上降低虚假-因果梯度比，在四个NLP基准与两个模型族上多数OOD评测中取得最优，显著超越标准KD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏旨在将高性能教师LLM压缩为轻量学生，但蒸馏学生在分布外（OOD）场景中常出现显著性能退化，这一关键问题仍缺乏系统研究。作者进一步指出两个叠加机制：一是数据虚假性，学生易在蒸馏数据上学习虚假相关而非真实因果关联；二是教师能力差异，标准KD对所有样本一视同仁，忽略教师在某样本上究竟依赖因果特征还是被虚假捷径误导。

Method: 提出Invariance-Weighted Distillation（IWD），一个有理论基础的框架，基于跨多个合成环境的预测不变性估计教师的因果依赖程度，并据此动态重加权训练样本。具体地，IWD对虚假线索进行扰动而保留核心语义，对教师预测保持不变的样本赋以更高蒸馏权重，表明其更依赖因果而非虚假特征。

Result: 理论上证明IWD相较于均匀加权的标准KD能降低学生的虚假-因果（S2C）梯度比，促使学生习得更具不变性的表征。实验在四个NLP基准（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2）和两个模型族（DeBERTa-v3、Qwen-2.5）上进行，IWD在OOD评测中持续优于强KD基线，同时保持有竞争力的ID性能；在16个OOD基准中15个取得最高准确率，平均OOD性能较标准KD在NLI上提升4.34个百分点、在QA上提升14.94个百分点。

Conclusion: IWD通过基于因果不变性的样本重加权有效缓解蒸馏学生在OOD场景下的性能退化，理论分析与跨基准、跨模型族实验共同验证其有效性与泛化性，为提升知识蒸馏的分布外鲁棒性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

</details>


### [300] [Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22603)
*Nikhil Reddy Pottanigari,Ramin Fahimi,Noah Bolger,Sepideh Kharaghani,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Semantic Scaffold 评估框架，通过从源文本提取事实、问题与实体属性的层次化表示（并标注主次信息）作为固定参考，衍生出 FPS、QPS、EPS 三个诊断指标，以解决 ROUGE 仅测表层重叠、LLM-as-judge 评分饱和无法有效排序模型的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要生成广泛部署于生产系统，模型选择依赖摘要质量度量。但现有指标存在缺陷：ROUGE 只能捕捉表层词汇重叠，LLM-as-judge 分数饱和、趋于近似值，难以有效区分和排序模型。作者在三个公开数据集、两个私有数据集以及多语言设置中均观察到这种饱和现象，因此需要更具区分度的评估方法。

Method: 提出 Semantic Scaffold 评估框架。该框架从源文本中提取事实（facts）、问题（questions）与实体属性（entity attributes）的层次化表示，并将每项标注为主要观点（main point）或支撑细节（supporting detail），随后将该结构作为固定参考用于摘要评分。基于此表示衍生三个诊断指标：事实保留分数（FPS）、问题保留分数（QPS）与实体保留分数（EPS），旨在奖励核心信息保留、惩罚细节冗余。

Result: 在三个公开数据集、两个私有数据集及多语言设置中观察到 LLM-as-judge 评分饱和现象；所提框架将 FPS、QPS、EPS 定位为可解释的诊断指标，在整体性评估轴失效时仍保持信息量；并分析了 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 的四类反复出现的失败模式。

Conclusion: 基于 scaffold 的评估在传统指标失效之处仍能提供有效信息，FPS、QPS、EPS 可作为可解释的诊断工具，弥补 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 在模型排序与信息区分上的不足。

Abstract: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

</details>


### [301] [Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22607)
*Minwoo Kang,Téa Wright,Seun Eisape,Ayush Raj,Suhong Moon,Joseph Suh,Alane Suhr,David M. Chan,John Canny*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出用指令微调助手模型扮演人设的主流做法不准确且导致刻板化预测，提出用简短对话样本绑定人设的"Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)"，其预测更准确且保留更多人类对话多样性，并进一步提出结合预训练模型与指令微调监督者的tandem模型以兼顾准确性与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM人类模拟的主流做法是提示指令微调助手模型进行人设角色扮演，但该做法不准确，并产生缺乏自然多样性的刻板化预测。已有研究表明可用自然化的自由文本对话将LLM绑定到人设且避免刻板化，本文旨在探索更有效的绑定方式与模型方案。

Method: 提出使用特定人物的简短、个体化对话样本实现人设绑定；人口统计信息可在后期通过简单查询模型添加而无负面影响。将这类校准良好的人类模型称为Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)，目前以预训练基础模型实现。进一步提出tandem模型，将预训练模型与指令微调监督者相结合。在涵盖开放域文本、人机聊天和人类说话者间任务导向对话的多种语料上测量LLM模拟人类对话者的真实性与多样性。

Result: PMMs比指令微调模型产生更准确的预测，并保留更多人类对话中的词汇、语义和语用多样性。但预训练基础模型可能产生域外对话，且在长上下文中可能丢失部分人类内部状态。tandem模型在实验中取得最佳的总体准确性与多样性。

Conclusion: 用简短个体对话样本绑定人设的PMMs优于指令微调的角色扮演做法；针对基础模型的域外对话与长上下文状态丢失问题，tandem模型（预训练模型+指令微调监督者）在准确性和多样性上表现最佳，为更校准的人类模拟提供了方向。

Abstract: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

</details>


### [302] [Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22633)
*Suchir Salhan,Catherine Arnett,James Michaelov,Paula Buttery*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Beetle——一个可控的双语语言模型预训练框架，并发布 285 个双语与 45 个单语开源模型，用于系统研究训练条件对二语行为的影响；实验发现分阶段、时间结构化的课程比均衡双语训练更贴合人类阅读时间数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有双语语言模型研究通常同时改变暴露结构、规模和架构等多个因素，难以将效应归因于单一变量；同时计算心理语言学长期以单语、英语为中心，缺乏研究人类双语加工与跨语言学习动态的受控工具。

Method: 构建 Beetle 可控预训练框架，使分词器、目标语言、训练预算与暴露结构可独立操控；据此训练并开源 285 个双语模型和 45 个单语模型，覆盖多种暴露日程、数据规模和第一语言，并保存丰富检查点，在人类双语/二语阅读时间预测与语法性判断任务上进行评测。
