Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.

</details>


### [337] [BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23490)
*Peng Kuang,Yuchun Fan,Jiangnan Li,Minghao Wu,Jialong Tang,Hao-Ran Wei,Weixuan Wang,Jianhong Tu,Baosong Yang,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 BabelFlow 流程构建多语言 Agent 基准 BabelArena（16,146 条实例，覆盖 4 类基准、13 领域、23 语言），揭示前沿模型在多语言 Agent 任务上的跨语言能力差异、失败模式与 token 效率问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 Agent 评测以英语为中心，无法反映多语言场景下的 Agent 能力表现，缺乏可复用、语义保真的多语言 Agent 基准构建方法。

Method: BabelFlow：一套基准通用（benchmark-general）的 Agent 工作流适配方法，通过运行时依赖分析、结构保持的翻译协调，并结合多层自动验证与人工复核，在翻译过程中保留任务与评测语义。基于该方法构建 BabelArena，从 4 类基准家族、13 个领域、702 个规范任务派生出 16,146 条任务对齐实例，覆盖 23 种语言。

Result: 5 个前沿模型评测显示：无单一模型在所有基准家族上占优；跨语言差距不仅体现在任务成功率上。低资源语言出现不同失败模式，工具调用与控制流错误占比更高，而非仅是答案质量问题。相同任务下，低资源语言消耗 token 显著更多（输入最高约 2 倍），但交互轮次未见同比例增长；在结构化输出任务上语言一致性进一步下降，语言切换绝大多数指向英语。

Conclusion: BabelArena 为可靠且高效的多语言 Agent 研究提供了基础设施，表明多语言 Agent 的可靠性、效率与语言一致性仍存在显著缺口。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.

</details>


### [338] [Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23551)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用分层旋转位置编码(hRoPE)将段落、句子、词元索引表示为独立通道,通过干预段落坐标并测量跨段落注意力,发现注意力压缩深度(而非位置)才是真实段落结构的可复现标志。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准位置编码将位置表示为一维阅读顺序坐标,但阅读顺序本身无法确定文本的层级结构,因此需要探讨模型注意力是否能反映真实的段落层级结构。

Method: 采用分层旋转位置编码(hRoPE),将段落、句子、词元索引设为独立通道,固定词元序列并干预段落坐标p1,使用词元距离精确估计器测量跨段落注意力;同时设置密度匹配随机标签的架构相同对照通道。

Result: 在所有语料中注意力相对词元距离匹配基线均出现压缩,但压缩本身不具诊断性——随机标签对照通道同样被压缩(程度更浅)。真正区分真实结构的是压缩深度:真实结构压缩更深且依赖语料,对照则不依赖。在三个构念(词汇持续性、段落长度、基于嵌入的一致性)的八项纯语料量中,无一能完全复现压缩深度的跨语料排序,其中基于嵌入的一致性最接近。

Conclusion: 压缩深度而非压缩位置,是该设定下真实段落结构可复现的标志。

Abstract: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.

</details>


### [339] [Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23573)
*Duy Anh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出将错误监督引入合成作文生成：用错误标注文本微调LLM生成器，使合成作文含学习者式错误，提升AES评分器在合成数据上的训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AES依赖人工标注数据，而合成作文虽可减少这种依赖，却缺少真实错误，难以代表语言学习者写作，限制其替代真实数据的价值。

Method: 在常用于语法错误检测（GED）的错误标注文本上微调LLM生成器，把错误监督注入合成作文；随后在三种数据条件下微调并评估AES评分器：真实作文、常规合成作文、本方法合成作文。

Result: 较大数据量设置下，本方法在12个数据集-指标对比中的11个优于常规合成基线，部分接近真实作文训练的模型；极端低资源下结果不一，需到200篇训练作文时才较明显占优，且跨数据集不一致。定性与定量分析显示生成错误分布大体接近真实作文中的学习者错误。

Conclusion: 错误监督可显著提升合成作文的真实性与AES训练效用，但仍未完全替代真实数据，尤其在极低资源场景下效果不稳定。

Abstract: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.

</details>


### [340] [ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23582)
*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ARID在8 GB Jetson Orin NX上从无标注工单中抽取结构化维护信息，输出固定JSON模式；参考栈token-F1 84.8%，部署端82.9%，P50/P99为5,310/5,656 ms @12.5 W。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维护工单常需在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，而下游软件要求可预测的结构化输出。因此需要一种能在受限算力下稳定产出固定schema的抽取方案，而非仅追求云端精度。

Method: ARID（Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment）组合以下技术：保守式双教师过滤、针对性噪声感知合成、每工单一次路由决策、4-bit推理、语法约束解码。数据侧从2,326条无标注OMIn记录中保留716对训练样本，并新增99条拓扑约束记录以强化动作抽取。

Result: 在300条人工标注记录上，参考栈token-F1为84.8%，部署Jetson端为82.9%；常驻服务P50/P99为5,310/5,656 ms，功耗12.5 W。零样本迁移至MaintNet时语义F1降至46.4%，但解析成功率仍不低于99.8%。

Conclusion: 方法可在边缘设备上实现可用的结构化抽取精度与延迟-功耗折中；零样本迁移表明输出格式合法性（可解析性）可迁移，但字段语义不可迁移，需领域适配或再标注。

Abstract: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.

</details>


### [341] [On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23587)
*Yifei Yang,Zouying Cao,Xingrui Wang,Xiao Zhou,Yuexian Li,Dongjie Yang,Hai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究首次系统分析了大推理模型（LRM）中效率技术（量化、剪枝）与越狱脆弱性及推理能力之间的相互作用，揭示效率方法表面降低越狱成功率实为推理能力退化的假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型推理成本高昂，常通过量化和剪枝等效率技术缓解，但这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性的影响尚不明确，存在安全性评估的空白。

Method: 对效率、越狱脆弱性与推理三者进行综合分析，并结合表征漂移的机制分析（representational drift），比较量化、剪枝及其组合等效率策略。

Result: 效率方法看似降低越狱攻击成功率，但这一改善是表面的，主要源于推理能力退化导致"尝试但失败"的恶意响应，而非真正对齐增强；表征漂移机制分析证实推理能力损失与模型无法维持恶意语义轨迹之间存在严格耦合；量化结合剪枝是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最优策略。

Conclusion: 研究厘清了真正安全对齐与能力诱导失败之间的区别，为LRM部署提供了实证基础。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.

</details>


### [342] [Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23697)
*Jie Sun,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Zeyuan Liu,Gengsheng Li,Houcheng Jiang,Yilin Cheng,Bichuan Feng,Yuchen Cai,Junfeng Fang,Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 TrustMOPD，用无标签的 token 级监督分配替代示例级教师选择，在多教师在线策略蒸馏中按学生生成前缀动态加权各专家教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多教师在线策略蒸馏中，域路由方法每个样本只选一位教师并在整条回答中固定不变。这既依赖混合语料常缺失的标签，也无法在轨迹内部专业需求变化时调整教师选择。

Method: TrustMOPD 在每个学生生成的 prefix 上，用各专家教师相对共享 pre-RL reference 的 RL 诱导位移作为其局部可靠性代理，跨教师校准这些分数，并据此构造加权蒸馏目标，实现无标签、token 级的监督分配。

Result: 在数学、代码和指令跟随任务上，TrustMOPD 超过最强无标签基线：SingleCap 恢复率由 54.4% 提升到 91.5%，MultiCap 由 54.5% 提升到 98.0%，并在 SingleCap 上接近基于标签的 MOPD。将 token 级权重随机化、脱离学生生成前缀时，效果不优于均匀加权。

Conclusion: 将监督条件化于不断演化的生成上下文对多教师在线策略蒸馏至关重要，token 级、无标签的可靠性加权能有效替代示例级教师路由。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. Across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD outperforms the strongest label-free baseline, increasing the recovery ratio from $54.4\%$ to $91.5\%$ on \textsc{SingleCap} and from $54.5\%$ to $98.0\%$ on \textsc{MultiCap}, while approaching label-based MOPD on \textsc{SingleCap}. Randomizing token-level weights independently of the student-generated prefix performs no better than uniform weighting, supporting the importance of conditioning supervision on the evolving generation context.

</details>


### [343] [Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23703)
*Kemal Kirtac*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MFAST——一个"市场摩擦感知"的金融文本情感到交易决策框架，将带时间戳的财经新闻转化为可审计、可复现且市场可行的交易信号，并强调金融语言模型的可信评估必须采用端到端工程化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融语言模型能将非结构化公司新闻转化为结构化决策信号，但金融AI研究缺乏统一的部署评估框架。计算机科学的时序预测、文本分类、多模态股票预测、图市场建模与MLOps各有方法，却无法在事件时间可观测性、概率校准、执行时点、交易成本、流动性约束、容量上限、运维诊断与统计推断等维度联合检验金融语言模型输出。

Method: 提出MFAST（Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading）框架：将带时间戳的金融文本转换为可审计、可复现、市场可行的交易决策，应用场景为新闻驱动的交易。技术上，将Refinitiv News Analytics与CRSP股票数据关联；将主要样本外评估限定于发布时间晚于已披露基础模型数据新鲜期的新闻，以规避数据泄漏；并增设使用公开金融文本与公开价格数据的公开复现分支。

Result: 仅解码器（decoder-only）语言模型在分类、概率校准、收益预测与组合净表现上均优于编码器基线和词典情感方法；运维诊断揭示了准确率、延迟、内存、吞吐量与推理成本之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 对金融语言模型的可信评估需要端到端工程化方法，整合语言理解、时间纪律、市场摩擦感知部署与可复现验证，而非仅关注单一建模指标。

Abstract: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. The application is news-based trading, where firm-specific text must be linked to securities before portfolio decisions can be evaluated. The framework links Refinitiv News Analytics to Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) equity data, restricts the primary out-of-sample evaluation to post-release news outside disclosed foundation-model data-freshness periods, and adds a public replication arm using open financial text and public price data. Results show that decoder-only language models outperform encoder baselines and dictionary sentiment in classification, calibration, return prediction, and net portfolio performance, while operational diagnostics reveal trade-offs among accuracy, latency, memory, throughput, and inference cost. The paper shows that credible evaluation of financial language models requires an end-to-end engineering approach combining language understanding, temporal discipline, market-friction-aware deployment, and reproducible validation.

</details>


### [344] [STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23716)
*Yifan Xu,Yixuan Li,Xinzhuo Li,Yixin Gu,Yifan Shen,Lijun Yu,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: STEVE是一个通过错误驱动精炼与正则化验证两个机制来稳定文本梯度提示优化的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本梯度方法通过自然语言反馈实现提示自动优化，但其迭代更新不稳定。作者识别出两个不稳定来源：一是从已正确样本产生的噪声梯度，二是对困难样本的过度特化导致简单输入性能退化。

Method: STEVE包含两个耦合机制：（1）Error-Driven Refinement，仅从处理错误的样本生成梯度，将更新集中于有信息量的失败案例；（2）Regularized Verification，将每次更新视为暂定，只有当困难样本上的提升不引起保留集上不可接受的退化时才接受该更新。

Result: 在十个推理基准、三种评估器/优化器模型及已有提示优化基线上，STEVE减少了性能退化并产生更稳健的提示；在符号推理、GSM8K-Platinum和DS-1000上使用gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4的额外评估表明收益在新模型和更大测试集下依然保持。

Conclusion: STEVE为提升文本梯度提示优化的稳定性与有效性提供了实用途径。

Abstract: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. Additional evaluations with gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4 on symbolic reasoning, GSM8K-Platinum, and DS-1000 show that these gains persist with newer models and larger test sets. STEVE therefore provides a practical way to improve the stability and effectiveness of textual-gradient prompt optimization.

</details>


### [345] [GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23726)
*Jiakang Xu,Wantong Huo,Udom Silparcha,Jonathan H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GRACE：一个包含1,915条加拿大联邦立法问答-推理-答案实例的数据集，覆盖对抗性辩护、不确定性与应用推理三种模式；基于此微调出轻量模型CLeAR-4B，在提供法条时可显著提升与教师输出的一致性和法条引用行为，但无法条时接地能力急剧下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律NLP基准很少评估"提出并辩护法律立场""在不完整信息下推理""综合多条法条"的能力，且加拿大法律在研究中严重不足。论文旨在填补这一空白，构建基于加拿大联邦立法的接地推理数据集，并验证其能否支撑轻量级法律模型的开发。

Method: 构建流水线：首先对原始法条文本进行切分，然后生成场景化的问题与推理链，再通过无模型的引用验证与基于LLM的质量审核进行过滤，最终形成GRACE数据集（1,915条，三种推理模式）。作为概念验证，在Qwen3-4B基座上进行微调，得到CLeAR-4B，并在开卷与闭卷两种设置下与未修改的基座模型对比评估。

Result: 在提供相关法案文本时，CLeAR-4B在与教师输出的一致性和法定引用行为上均有显著提升；但在撤去法条文本后，其接地能力急剧下降。

Conclusion: GRACE可用于支持轻量级法律模型的开发，使其能更有效地基于所提供法条文本进行推理；同时结果表明模型的能力高度依赖上下文中是否提供法条，凸显了检索/接地环节的必要性。

Abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. GRACE covers three reasoning modes: adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning. We develop a pipeline that partitions raw statutory text, generates scenario-based questions and reasoning, and filters examples through model-free citation verification and LLM-based quality auditing. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune CLeAR-4B (Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning), a lightweight model for grounded legal reasoning, and evaluate it against the unmodified Qwen3-4B base model in open- and closed-book settings. CLeAR-4B substantially improves agreement with teacher outputs and statutory citation behavior when the relevant act text is provided, while its grounding degrades sharply when the statute is withheld. These results suggest that GRACE can support the development of lightweight legal models that reason more effectively from supplied statutory text.

</details>


### [346] [Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23742)
*Akash Chavan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在小参数开源LLM（0.6B–4B）上系统评测约束解码（CD）对结构化输出生成的影响，发现CD可完全消除结构错误，但语义准确性仍存在与模型规模相关的持续差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 0.6B–4B小参数量开源LLM正日益用于JSON生成、函数调用、数据抽取等结构化输出，但人们对约束解码（CD）与模型规模在该区间如何交互尚缺乏认识。

Method: 对来自3个家族的5个模型，在14个结构化输出任务上，比较三种解码条件（native、Outlines、XGrammar），并提出结构正确性（schema有效性）与语义正确性（内容准确性）分离的双轴评测方法。

Result: CD使所有模型的结构失败完全消失，schema有效率从78.6–92.9%提升到100%；但内容准确性仍显示持续的语义差距且依赖模型规模：类型强制转换失败可被CD补救，指令语义类失败（如多步函数调用）无法被CD补救。

Conclusion: schema符合性是语义正确的必要条件但非充分条件；CD的作用边界恰好终止于schema符合性之处。

Abstract: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.

</details>


### [347] [FLARE: A Full-Lifecycle Dense Supervision Paradigm for Long-Horizon Coding Agents via Generative Reward Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23808)
*Jingxuan Xu,Gang Wu,Yanan Wu,Yutao Mou,Songwei Yu,Tianzhuang He,Zhengshuo Gong,Zhao Liu,Zihang Xu,Wenqiang Zhu,Xinping Lei,Weihao Li,Yuhui Bai,Zhongqiu Wang,Yan Wu,Ariel Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FLARE——基于轻量生成式奖励模型（GRM）的全生命周期稠密监督范式，通过RADAR离线因果诊断蒸馏GRM，在推理与后训练阶段提供实时步级风险反馈，显著提升长程SWE智能体性能并降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程软件工程任务中，LLM智能体的测试时扩展虽有效，但稀疏二值奖励（Pass/Fail）导致严重的信用分配危机，并浪费大量失败探索轨迹；现有轨迹优化与扩展方法成本高、结构受限，依赖启发式状态复用而无因果诊断，或采用延迟标量评分而缺乏可操作的在线指导。

Method: 提出FLARE（Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine），一种由轻量生成式奖励模型（GRM）驱动的稠密监督范式。其一，RADAR离线因果感知诊断框架，通过因果链回溯提取高保真、无事后偏见的监督信号，蒸馏出可提供实时步级风险反馈的GRM。其二，FLARE在全生命周期持续优化智能体：推理时作为主动脚手架（Active Scaffold），自主拦截高风险生成步骤并进行局部断点重执行，大幅降低算力开销；后训练时，GRM的结构化信号用作SFT的过程监督重排序评分，以及RL的步级稠密奖励，缓解稀疏环境下的策略崩溃。

Result: FLARE在智能体全生命周期上建立了新的帕累托前沿：FLARE（N=1）以5倍的token消耗缩减超越Global Rollout（N=5）；扩展至训练后可克服长程交互任务中的稀疏奖励问题，SFT通过过程感知数据策划取得19.13%的相对性能提升，RL取得稳定的9.19%提升。

Conclusion: 以轻量GRM为核心的稠密监督范式可有效解决稀疏奖励下的信用分配与轨迹浪费问题，兼顾推理效率与训练效果，为长程交互型LLM智能体提供了统一的推理-训练优化框架。

Abstract: While test-time scaling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon software engineering (SWE), sparse binary rewards (Pass/Fail) create a severe credit assignment crisis and waste failed exploratory trajectories. Current trajectory optimization and scaling methods are costly and structurally limited, relying on heuristic state reuse without causal diagnosis or delayed scalar scoring without actionable online guidance. We propose FLARE (Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine), a novel dense supervision paradigm driven by a lightweight Generative Reward Model (GRM). First, RADAR, an offline causal-aware diagnostic framework, extracts high-fidelity, hindsight-free supervision through causal-chain backtracking to distill a GRM providing real-time, step-level risk feedback. Second, FLARE uses this GRM to continuously optimize the agent across its entire lifecycle. During inference, FLARE acts as an Active Scaffold, autonomously intercepting high-risk generation steps for localized breakpoint re-execution, drastically reducing compute overhead. During post-training, the GRM's structured signals serve as process-supervised reranking scores for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and step-level dense rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL), mitigating policy collapse in sparse environments. Extensive evaluations show that FLARE establishes a new Pareto frontier across the agent lifecycle: FLARE (N=1) outperforms Global Rollout (N=5) with a 5x reduction in token consumption. Extending FLARE to training overcomes the sparse reward problem in long-horizon interactive tasks, delivering relative performance gains of 19.13% in SFT through process-aware data curation and a consistent 9.19% improvement in RL.

</details>


### [348] [Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs: Architecture and Aggregation Strategy Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23825)
*Jordi Luque,Aleix Sant,Fernando López*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对联邦学习（FL）下的多语言语音识别（ASR）建立了综合基准，在Multilingual LibriSpeech上评估四种Speech-LLM架构，比较FedAvg与FedProx及编码器冻结/解冻配置，发现分层学习率调优与三组件全面适配最优，且FedProx收益依赖架构与LLM骨干容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私敏感的分布式场景需要多语言Speech-LLM部署方案，但联邦学习在该任务上缺乏系统性基准，尤其是聚合算法、编码器冻结策略与学习率配置（语音编码器、连接器、解码器）对性能的影响尚不明确。

Method: 在Multilingual LibriSpeech数据集上，对四种Speech-LLM架构构建FL基准；对比FedAvg与FedProx，在编码器冻结与解冻两种配置下实验；对语音编码器、连接器、解码器三部分独立调优学习率，并测试三组件全面适配（编码器与解码器用LoRA，连接器全量训练）。

Result: 独立调优编码器、连接器、解码器学习率可获得最低错误率；三组件全面适配（编码器/解码器LoRA+连接器全量训练）取得最佳FL效果；FedProx的有效性依赖架构，在多语言预训练架构（如编码器固定时EuroLLM优于TinyLlama）中优势明显。

Conclusion: LLM骨干容量是决定对异构数据分布鲁棒性的关键因素；研究结果为在隐私敏感、分布式环境中部署多语言Speech-LLM提供了具体的设计指导。

Abstract: We present a comprehensive benchmark of Federated Learning (FL) for multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), evaluating four Speech-LLM architectures on the Multilingual LibriSpeech dataset. We compare FedAvg and FedProx across frozen and unfrozen encoder configurations, demonstrating that optimized learning rates are critical for performance. Specifically, independently tuning the learning rates for the speech encoder, connector, and decoder yields the lowest error rates, with full three-component adaptation (LoRA for encoder and decoder, full training for the connector) producing the best FL results. We observe that FedProx efficacy is architecture-dependent, providing notable advantages in multilingual pre-trained architectures (e.g., EuroLLM over TinyLlama when keeping the encoder fixed); this indicates that LLM backbone capacity plays a key role in mediating resilience to heterogeneous data distributions. These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.

</details>


### [349] [From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23853)
*Camilla Andreozzi,Phuong-Anh Nguyen-Le,Zhijing Jin,Revati Mani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LLM流水线，将灾害风险减灾档案文本转为符合受控灾害词表与固定模式的候选地理定位事件记录，并保留可审查证据。在PreventionWeb万篇文档上产出3,572条记录，覆盖24类灾害，81%地点提及可解析为OSM几何；GPT-5在171个人工正例窗口上取得86.0%的合并属性F1，显著优于44.2%的spaCy-地名库基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害风险减灾档案以自然语言叙述灾害事件，EM-DAT等数据库无法直接摄取，人工整理成本高、难以规模化，因此需要自动化抽取方法将非结构化叙述转化为结构化、可核查的事件记录。

Method: 构建基于LLM的抽取流水线，采用受控灾害词表与固定schema生成带地理定位的候选事件记录，并保留逐字证据以支持人工复核；使用OpenStreetMap几何解析地点提及；在PreventionWeb的10,000篇文档上运行，并在217篇分层参考集（含171个人工正例窗口）上评测，比较GPT-5与spaCy-地名库基线及十种LLM，同时开展标签与地点规则的自动化合规检查并报告生产失败模式。

Result: 从1,913篇文档中生成3,572条事件记录，覆盖24种灾害类型，81%地点提及解析到OpenStreetMap几何；在171个人工正例文档窗口上GPT-5取得86.0%合并属性F1（基线44.2%），GPT-5.4在十种LLM中排名最高（86.6% F1）；逐字证据出现率为GPT-5 72.0%、GPT-5.4 47.2%。评测在文档内部合并灾害类别、地点字符串与事件年份，未评估其到单个事件的归属。

Conclusion: 该LLM流水线可在保留证据可追溯性的前提下，从大量灾害叙述档案中规模化生成结构化、地理定位的事件记录，性能显著优于传统基线；但现有评测未验证属性向单个事件的分配，逐字证据也不等同于属性支持，需进一步验证。提示词、schema与输出将公开，以支持各国上报档案的适配。

Abstract: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

</details>


### [350] [Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23880)
*Soyeon Kim,Hyunjin Kim,JinYeong Bak,Steven Euijong Whang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Q-TIE，一种基于可学习时间意图抽取（TIE）的时间信息检索重排序框架，将查询的时间约束映射为统一区间表示，结合了时间检索器与时间重排序器的互补优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TIR 对 RAG 日益关键，时间不匹配的证据会严重误导结果。现有两类范式各有短板：时间检索器虽能通过可学习表示灵活理解查询，但往往无法显式建模时间约束；时间重排序器虽能更显式地施加约束，却依赖预定义的重排序规则，泛化性受限。

Method: 提出 Q-TIE 重排序框架，核心是可学习的 TIE 模型，将每个查询的时间约束映射为统一区间表示 ⟨t_start, t_end⟩。通过基于模型的学习替代预设规则，同时将时间约束作为独立信号显式建模，从而同时兼顾两类范式各自的优势。

Result: 实验表明 Q-TIE 一致优于现有 TIR 方法，在不同时间查询类型上具有更强的泛化性，并可作为轻量且有效的插件用于时间感知的 RAG 流程。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过可学习的时间意图抽取与统一区间表示，Q-TIE 弥合了时间检索器与时间重排序器之间的权衡，为时间感知 RAG 提供了一种轻量、通用且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.

</details>


### [351] [this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23886)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 2B 参数的类型化决策模型 this-that-model-1.0，直接从指定位置的隐藏状态读出答案并限制在调用方声明的选项集合内，不生成任何 token；单张消费级 GPU 上 30.9 ms 完成一次决策、32 决策/秒，在第三方 68 题队列上准确率 0.941（Brier 0.042），优于托管服务 Jev 的 0.765/0.133，且在多步算术等需中间步骤的任务上明显落后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件越来越多地把分支决策（工单进入哪个队列、命令是否安全、理赔能否自动结清）委托给模型，但程序真正需要的不是自然语言文本，而是 n 个已声明选项之一加一个可阈值化的数值。当前做法要往返调用前沿模型，带来数百毫秒延迟、按 token 计费以及解析器开销，而问题本身往往只是三个子句的合取，成本与收益严重不匹配。

Method: 构建 2B 参数的"类型化决策模型"：答案不是生成的文本，而是从指定位置的隐藏状态直接读取，并被约束到调用方声明的选项集合内，因此输出不可能畸形；同一请求中的每个问题在同一次前向传播中一并作答。模型在 https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0 开源。

Result: 单张笔记本 GPU 上每次决策 30.9 ms、零输出 token，消费级 GPU 上 32 决策/秒，状态不出本机；对照前沿 API 调用需 8758 ms，表现良好的托管系统每题先"思考"并计费生成 21–212 个 token。第三方记录的 68 题决策队列（使用其输入与措辞）上得分 0.941、Brier 0.042，同批题目上托管服务 Jev 为 0.765 与 0.133。内部 42 族套件一遍耗时 32 秒、电费 0.000217 美元，而所测最准的托管模型需 155.2 分钟、10.636 美元。失败面：多步算术上得分 0.560，对比对方 0.98–1.00，原因是单次前向无法携带中间结果；一次针对性第二轮训练仅提升其针对的 5 个任务族，未能迁移到其余 13 个。

Conclusion: 对"声明式选项 + 数值"这类高频、结构化决策，用小型专用模型直接读取隐藏状态，可同时消除生成延迟、token 计费与输出解析，大幅降低时延与成本，并在真实第三方队列上超过托管服务；其边界在于单次前向无法处理需要中间状态的多步推理，且专项训练迁移性差。

Abstract: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0

</details>


### [352] [Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23916)
*Fırat Öncel,Salman Hussain Ali,Mirco Ravanelli,Cem Subakan,Çağatay Yıldız*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究"时间增量式持续预训练（CPT）"，即用严格晚于模型知识截止点的FineWeb-Edu数据继续预训练，并在3个家族、4个参数规模（1B–8B）的6个开源模型上评估。结论：知识可获得且无灾难性遗忘，通用能力成本极低（13任务宏平均波动≤0.01），数据质量优于数量，LoRA足量秩可媲美全量CPT，收益可通过SFT迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练结束即过时，而从头重训代价过高。CPT是自然解法，但现有评估多沿用持续学习视角，假设数据流互不相交；这与网页规模抓取的时间增量更新现实不符——相邻快照在设计上存在大量URL重叠。作者希望在这一更真实的设定下重新审视时间增量式CPT，检验其是否真的如持续学习文献所暗示的那样代价高昂、易遗忘。

Method: 围绕四个实践问题组织实验：(i) 知识是否习得；(ii) 代价几何；(iii) 配方如何（数据质量vs数量、学习率、LoRA vs全量）；(iv) 是否经得起部署。在6个开源权重模型（OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B，1B–8B）上，用严格来自各自知识截止点之后的FineWeb-Edu数据dump进行CPT，并在事实召回与13任务通用能力套件上评测，同时考察SFT与DPO后的迁移表现。

Result: (i) 知识确实习得但不均衡，且无灾难性遗忘：6个模型中5个在截止点前事实召回上也有提升，增益与预训练饱和度（主要由每参数量token预算驱动）相关。(ii) 代价近乎为零：所有模型在13任务套件上的宏平均与基线差距不超过0.01。(iii) 配方方面：数据质量主导数量（精选6B token切片可对标更宽的40B）；知识获取与通用能力的最佳学习率相差约一个数量级；足够秩的LoRA可匹配全量CPT。(iv) 部署层面：CPT收益可经SFT迁移，而DPO的效果因模型家族而异。

Conclusion: 在贴近现实的网页时间增量CPT设定下，结果比既有持续学习文献更乐观：模型能在不牺牲通用能力的前提下更新知识，且成本极低、配方明确、收益可部署迁移。这提示以往基于不相交数据流的持续学习评估低估了时间增量CPT的可行性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B).
  We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.

</details>


### [353] [Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23935)
*Jord Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文检验"助手人设仅作用于自身回合"这一边界，发现安全相关偏好（偏好无害任务）会溢出到用户回合的预测中，说明后训练并非安装浅层人设，而是泛化进模型对用户的表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练将通用下一词预测器转变为具有持久助手人设的对话模型。若该人设只是模型在自身回合扮演的角色，其偏好应只支配助手说什么，而不应影响模型对他人（用户）发言的预测。作者据此检验这一边界是否成立。

Method: 在开放权重模型家族上对比预训练基座模型与后训练模型，测量助手"偏好无害任务胜过有害任务"这一安全相关偏好在用户回合预测中的体现；进行跨模型家族复现、规模趋势分析，以及不触及用户回合的窄域微调实验。

Result: 该偏好在预训练基座模型中很小或接近零，经后训练后出现，并在多个开放权重模型家族中复现，随规模增大而增强；且可被从未触及用户回合的窄域微调所改变。

Conclusion: 后训练并非仅安装一个浅层的助手人设，而是会超出局部助手回合，泛化进模型对用户的表征之中。

Abstract: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.

</details>


### [354] [XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23939)
*Zhengxuan Wu,Yuxuan Li,Oyvind Tafjord,Been Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将"XY问题"引入智能体评估，提出XYEval元评估框架，可将现有基准转化为XY问题评测，发现智能体在误导性建议下性能大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户与AI智能体的有效沟通是人机协作的关键。XY问题是常见沟通陷阱：用户询问的是其尝试的解决方案而非真实问题。已有谄媚性评估尚未覆盖智能体场景下的XY问题，即智能体能否抵御看似合理但具误导性的用户建议并清晰表达推理。

Method: 提出XYEval元评估框架，可对现有基准进行XY问题转化；在六个多样化基准套件上评估五个模型；并利用τ²-bench考察面对要求详细解释才批准更优方案的"学究型"用户时的表现；另设简单系统指令基线鼓励智能体识别XY问题；并进行大量轨迹分析。

Result: 智能体在XY变换下普遍出现大幅性能下降，相对降幅最高达46.7%；在τ²-bench中，遇到要求详细解释的学究型用户时性能下降更明显；仅靠系统指令基线只能部分缓解。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在面临误导性建议时缺乏有效推理与沟通能力。缓解XY问题仍具挑战，需智能体既识别用户误导，又能清晰传达底层真实问题。

Abstract: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.

</details>


### [355] [HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23951)
*Devangi Sharma,Sophia Judicke,Glenda Tan,Conrad Schaumburg,Shinji Watanabe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HaikuS2S是一种级联系统，结合ASR、LLM生成俳句与基于散文及自建俳句数据集的TTS微调，实现俳句语音合成，并在韵律与声调对齐上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表现性语音合成虽经韵律建模取得进展，但生成俳句等结构化诗歌语音仍具挑战。已有韵律迁移方法提升表现力，微调诗歌TTS可捕捉诗体语调，但这些模型未建模俳句的5-7-5音节结构与行末停顿。

Method: 提出级联系统HaikuS2S，由ASR、LLM生成俳句、以及在散文与自建俳句数据集上进行TTS微调三部分组成。评估维度包括情感相似度、语音质量和韵律对齐。

Result: 实验表明，经微调的系统在韵律与声调对齐上显著提升，尤其同时在一般诗歌与俳句数据上训练的系统；各系统间情感相似度得分保持相近。

Conclusion: HaikuS2S通过级联ASR、LLM与TTS微调，有效改善俳句语音的韵律与声调对齐，同时保持情感相似度，为结构化诗歌语音合成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.

</details>


### [356] [Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23955)
*Mai Mohamed Eida,Ryan Dolan,Paul de Nijs,Jonathan Dunn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示LLM对埃及阿拉伯语次方言存在的偏见：LLM在句法接受度判断上系统性偏好声望更高的开罗方言，并导致在MMLU等下游任务中面对Sa'idi方言时性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往埃及阿拉伯语NLP研究集中于声望较高的开罗方言（CEA），忽视了声望较低的Sa'idi方言（SEA），造成LLM与资源开发中的代表性缺失。作者希望探究这种缺失是否影响LLM对SEA可接受性的判断（上游偏见），以及上游偏见是否进一步导致下游任务性能下降。

Method: 采用定向句法评估（Targeted Syntactic Evaluation, TSE）任务，考察SEA方言特征对多个LLM偏好判断的上游影响；随后在MMLU基准上分析相同方言特征对下游模型性能的影响。

Result: TSE实验显示多个LLM对SEA存在显著偏见；在MMLU基准上，模型在呈现SEA方言时出现性能退化。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了子方言变异（sub-dialectal variation）对语言技术的重要影响，呼吁未来进一步探索此类较低资源子方言在LLM中的偏见与性能问题。

Abstract: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

</details>


### [357] [Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23959)
*Simiao Ren,Kidus Zewde,Xingyu Shen,Yuchen Zhou,Dennis Ng,Ankit Raj,Tommy Duong,Yuxin Zhang,Neo Tiangratanakul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在诈骗电话筛查任务中，将Qwen3-4B经LoRA微调，以两个标签logits的温度缩放softmax输出P(scam)；单次前向、无生成文本，逐轮给出毫秒级校准概率，性能不逊于LLM裁判且延迟更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 诈骗电话筛查需要在每一轮通话后、毫秒级时间内得到一个可信的概率判断。传统生成式LLM需要生成文本、延迟高，而"类型化决策"（声明选项输入、单次前向输出每个选项的校准概率、无生成文本）理论上更契合该需求，因此作者在一个开放实现上验证这一读出方式在真实筛查场景中的可行性。

Method: 采用JevLite这一开放实现的"类型化决策"读出：对Qwen3-4B进行LoRA微调，使两个答案标签logits经温度缩放softmax后即为P(scam)。在CallScreenBench的41个留出场景（577个逐轮决策）上评估，使用三种子集成，并与LLM裁判MiniMax-M3在预定0.02非劣性边界下比较；同时报告校准误差、误报与决策时延，并与微调后生成答案的同一骨干模型及微调的ModernBERT编码器对比。

Result: 三种子集成达到AUROC .974、校准误差 .052，在预注册0.02边界下不劣于MiniMax-M3裁判；对合法通话零误报；在相同挂断规则下平均提前1.14轮做出决策；单张消费级GPU上每次决策64.5 ms，比同一骨干微调为生成答案的方式低4.9倍。提升主要来自读出方式与校准而非准确率：微调后的ModernBERT编码器表现并无显著差距；配方选择过程中接触过测试集；所有来电者均为合成数据。

Conclusion: 论文不主张架构新颖性，其贡献在于将该读出方式应用于诈骗电话筛查，并提供了一份同时报告校准、误报与决策时延（而非仅AUROC）的评估。局限在于测试集暴露、合成来电者以及编码器基线相当，因此结论应谨慎外推。

Abstract: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.

</details>


### [358] [From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23966)
*Mai Mohamed Eida,Gunjan Anand,Ayush Singh,Aleksandre Maskharashvili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 STAT-TO-TEXT 受控任务，让 LLM 基于统计表生成含量化结构（all/some/no/most 等）的自然语言推断，并用自动生成的 Python 检查器验证其真值条件，比较四个开放权重 LLM 的忠实性、逻辑准确性、表格覆盖率与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 虽能就表格生成流畅描述，但这些输出可能在逻辑上并不被结构化数据支持，即存在“流畅但不忠实”的问题，需要一种可验证的评估方式来检验推断的逻辑有效性。

Method: 构建 STAT-TO-TEXT 任务，要求 LLM 从统计表中生成量化自然语言推断（使用 all、some、no、most 等量化词），并利用 LLM 生成的 Python 检查器代码，在运行时针对表格验证相应真值条件；跨模型家族与规模比较四个开放权重 LLM。

Result: 模型规模与家族影响表现：最大模型 GPT-OSS-120B 相比更小模型持续产生最忠实的推断，且未牺牲表格覆盖率与量化词多样性；人类标注显示自动检查器与人工判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 量化受控任务结合代码化真值验证，可有效评估 LLM 表格推断的逻辑忠实性；模型规模对忠实推理有积极作用，自动检查器可作为可靠替代人工的评估手段。

Abstract: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data. We introduce STAT-TO-TEXT, a controlled task in which LLMs generate quantified natural language inferences from statistical tables using quantified constructions such as all, some, no, and most. To evaluate these inferences, we use an LLM generated Python checker code which when executed verifies the corresponding truth conditions against the table. We compare four open-weight LLMs across model families and scales, evaluating faithfulness, logical accuracy, table coverage, and diversity. Our results show that model scale and family matter, with the largest model (GPT-OSS-120B) consistently producing the most faithful inferences without sacrificing greater table coverage and quantifier diversity, as opposed to smaller models. These findings are supported by human annotation, which shows that the automated checker closely aligns with human judgments.

</details>


### [359] [When Evidence Conflicts: Reliability-aware Meta-review Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24028)
*Xinzhe Wang,Fei Tao,Jiang Xie,Hong Yu,Ye Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出可靠性感知的证据聚合框架，从多篇同行评审生成元评审，在冲突与高冲突场景下均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有元评审生成多被建模为多文档摘要并均匀聚合评审意见，当评审证据冲突且可靠性参差时，难以判断应优先采纳哪些观点。

Method: 框架首先从同行评审中抽取方面级观点，识别每个方面内的冲突证据；再估计观点级支持度与评审级质量以衡量证据可靠性；据此为评审反馈分配可靠性感知权重，使生成器优先采纳支持更充分的论点并保留多样视角。

Result: 在自动与人工评估中持续优于强基线，并在高冲突评审场景下于冲突识别与消解方面取得明显提升。

Conclusion: 以可靠性感知证据聚合替代统一聚合，可有效提升元评审生成质量，尤其利于冲突处理；代码已公开。

Abstract: Generating coherent meta-reviews from multiple peer reviews is challenging when reviewer evidence conflicts and varies in reliability. Existing approaches typically formulate meta-review generation as a multi-document summarization task and aggregate reviewer feedback uniformly, making it difficult to determine which opinions should be prioritized under disagreement. In this paper, we study meta-review generation through reliability-aware evidence aggregation. Our framework first extracts aspect-level opinions from peer reviews and identifies conflicting evidence within each aspect. It then estimates opinion-level support and review-level quality to measure evidence reliability. Based on these signals, the framework assigns reliability-aware weights to reviewer feedback, enabling the generator to prioritize better-supported arguments while preserving diverse perspectives. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves meta-review generation over strong baselines on both automatic and human evaluations, with clear gains in conflict recognition and resolution under high-conflict review scenarios. The code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/Wangxz729/reliability-aware-meta-review.

</details>


### [360] [Calibrated Decisions at Scale: Converting Police Crash Narratives into Probabilistic Crash Variables with a System One Model (Jev)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24052)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将事故叙述编码形式化为"带门控的类型化决策"，用只输出概率、不生成文本的 System One 模型 Jev 完成大规模编码，并以既有编码字段和 2,416 条盲评人工判断进行审计与校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事故数据集中的调查员叙述含有编码字段所遗漏的信息，但大规模编码受三重障碍阻塞：前沿大模型在该规模下成本过高、其生成文本不可验证、且没有规则规定人工必须核查多少输出。

Method: 将叙述编码定义为带门控的类型化决策，由 System One 模型 Jev 在分析师定义的选项上返回概率且不生成文本。筛查覆盖 499,500 条得州叙述，其中 195,857 条按 27 问架构编码。概率对照编码字段及按既定抽样设计抽取的 2,416 条盲评人工判断进行审计，并在同一批记录上与两个前沿大模型基准比较。另提出针对离散概率网格的 resolution-floor 界，以及基于被标记记录的复核预算规则。

Result: 成本由架构规模而非叙述长度决定。相对人工标签，类型化模型 F1 为 0.908；一个前沿模型高出 0.059，另一个与其无显著差异。校准随模型而异而非随范式而异，故每个模型都须单独审计；在同一批标签上重校准使校准误差降至 1/3.3。与编码字段的一致度低估了对叙述的保真度，kappa 中位差 0.26。复核预算给出每变量、每年人工必读的记录数。将校准后的变量加入编码字段，使归因于九类因素的伤害与致死事故每年增加 10,747 起。

Conclusion: 只输出概率的类型化模型可在极大规模下低成本、可审计地完成叙述编码，其保真度高于与编码字段的一致度，且经校准后可显著补充现有编码字段所遗漏的事故信息。

Abstract: Crash datasets that carry an investigator narrative hold information the coded fields omit. Coding those narratives at scale has been blocked by three obstacles. Frontier large language models are costly at that scale, their generated text cannot be verified, and no rule says how much output a human must check. This paper formulates narrative coding as gated, typed decisions answered by Jev, a System One model that returns probabilities over analyst-defined options and generates no text. A screen covered 499,500 Texas narratives and 195,857 were coded with a 27-question schema. Cost is governed by schema size rather than narrative length. The probabilities are audited against coded fields and against 2,416 blinded human judgments drawn under a stated sampling design. Two frontier large language models are benchmarked on the same records. Against human labels the typed model attains an F1 of 0.908. One frontier model gains 0.059 and the other is indistinguishable from it. Calibration varies by model rather than by paradigm, so each model must be audited. Recalibration on the same labels reduces calibration error by a factor of 3.3. Agreement with coded fields understates fidelity to the narrative by a median of 0.26 in kappa. A resolution-floor bound covers any model that reports probabilities on a discrete grid. A review budget over flagged records gives the records a human must read per variable and per year. Adding the calibrated variables to the coded fields raises the injury and fatal crashes attributed to nine factors by 10,747 per year.

</details>


### [361] [Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering with Progress Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24066)
*Hengyuan Zhang,Chenming Shang,Zunhai Su,Xiao Liang,Hui Shen,Jing Xiong,Dawei Li,Shiping Yang,Kailai Yang,Wei Zhang,Ruobing Xie,Hayden Kwok-Hay So,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练隐空间引导框架SPS，通过状态条件化的进展引导向量，在高不确定转移处引导推理路径，缓解探索坍缩，提升Best-of-N推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N效果依赖采样候选能否覆盖多样且高质量的推理路径，但后训练推理模型常出现探索坍缩：独立采样反复沿相似路径，增大采样预算收益有限。现有方法虽促进更广探索，却未显式引导探索朝向有实质进展的续写，探索效率受限。

Method: SPS为免训练隐空间引导框架。构建状态条件化方向库（Direction Bank），包含针对不同前缀状态区域的多个进展引导引导向量；在线推理时，依据当前前缀状态检索合适引导向量，并在高不确定转移处施加，引导下一步推理走向有意义进展。代码见https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS。

Result: 在多种模型规模与基准上的实验表明，SPS持续优于强基线；进一步分析验证了其关键设计有效性，并为未来研究提供启示。

Conclusion: SPS通过状态条件化、进展引导的隐空间向量在高不确定转移处引导推理，缓解探索坍缩，提升Best-of-N的探索效率与性能。

Abstract: Best-of-$N$ is a widely used inference strategy for complex reasoning, whose effectiveness depends on whether sampled candidates can cover diverse and high-quality reasoning paths. However, post-trained reasoning models often suffer from \emph{exploration collapse}, where independent rollouts repeatedly follow similar reasoning paths and limit the gains from increasing the rollout budget. Existing methods alleviate this issue by promoting broader exploration, but do not explicitly guide exploration toward continuations that make meaningful progress, resulting in limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we propose \emph{\underline{S}tate-conditioned \underline{P}rogress-guided \underline{S}teering} (SPS), a training-free latent steering framework. Specifically, SPS constructs a state-conditioned Direction Bank containing multiple progress-guided steering vectors for different prefix-state regions. During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of its key designs and offer valuable insights for future research. The code is available at https://github.com/rattlesnakey/SPS.

</details>


### [362] [From Content Generation to Learning Support: Pedagogy-Guided Generative Video Tutors for STEM Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24083)
*Xinchen Ma,Shuimu Wang,Gaole He,Yanbin Zhang,Chunyang Wang,Yunshi Lan,Weining Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PIVOT 框架，将教学法嵌入生成式教育视频的全流程（分镜生成、多模态视频生成与验证、评估与误解纠正），在四个 STEM 领域的实验与专家评估中显示其内容教学对齐、表达清晰、流程连贯且具学习实效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 视频系统主要追求视觉连贯，而非支持学习，导致生成视频缺乏显式教学结构、可靠质量控制和评估学习者理解及纠正误解的机制。作者主张应从"能产出什么"转向"如何支持教学实践、学习者理解与纠错反馈"的人本视角。

Method: PIVOT（Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring）框架模拟传统教学工作流，将教学法贯穿生成全流程：先以教学原则指导分镜（storyboard）生成；再通过代码为中心的生成方式与"教学验证框架"（pedagogical verification harness）产出经验证的多模态视频；最后将视频与评估及误解感知的补救（remediation）环节相连。

Result: 在四个 STEM 领域的实验和专家评估表明，该框架生成的视频具有教学对齐的内容、清晰且具吸引力的呈现、连贯的教学流程，并被感知为对学习有效。

Conclusion: 研究提出教育内容生成的人本视角：生成系统不仅应依据其产出物评估与设计，还应依据其如何支持教学实践、学习者理解与纠正性反馈来评估与设计。

Abstract: Generative AI enables scalable production of educational videos, but current systems largely focus on producing visually coherent content rather than supporting learning. As a result, generated videos often lack explicit pedagogical structure, reliable quality control, and mechanisms for assessing learner understanding or addressing misconceptions. In this work, we introduce PIVOT (Pedagogy-guided Instructional VideO Tutoring), a generative video tutoring framework for STEM learning via learning-centered instructional support.1 Inspired by conventional teaching workflows, our framework integrates pedagogy into the full generation pipeline: it first uses instructional principles to guide storyboard generation, then produces verified multimodal videos through code-centric generation and a pedagogical verification harness, and finally connects videos with assessment and misconception-aware remediation. Experiments and expert evaluations across four STEM domains show that our framework produces educational videos with pedagogically aligned content, clear and engaging presentation, coherent instructional flow, and perceived effectiveness for learning. These findings suggest a human-centered perspective on educational content generation: generative systems should be evaluated and designed not only by what they produce, but also by how they support teaching practices, learner understanding, and corrective feedback.

</details>


### [363] [You Can Tell Who's Asking: What the Web's Questions Are Made Of, and Where They Come From](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24106)
*Calvin Zhou,Vincent McCloskey,Krishna Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过对110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中134亿次问题出现进行大规模分析，检验了“网页问题反映人类真实意图”这一假设，发现网页问题的来源可被形式特征区分，高频问题多为模板化内容，且十二年间真实用户问题占比大幅下降（79%），揭示了可爬取网页问题从“人问”向“为机器制造”的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学界与业界普遍将网络抓取的问题作为人类信息需求的代理，用于QA训练数据、检索基准和内容策略，但这一假设缺乏大规模实证检验。论文旨在验证网页问题是否真实反映人类提问意图。

Method: 从110个FineWeb快照（2013-2025）中提取134亿次问题出现，进行历时性的、出现级别的问题来源测量；使用逻辑回归模型，基于问题长度与上下文（而非问题类型）区分真实用户问题与模板化/制造问题。

Result: 1）来源可识别：逻辑模型以AUC 0.725区分真实用户问题与模板化问题，但针对商业FAQ写作仅0.554；2）频率不等于需求：最高频问题中超过70%为模板/样板内容，出现次数衡量的是字符串被发布的频率而非被提问的频率；3）十二年间真实问题占比下降79%（控制抓取构成后为42%-56%），问题长度与上下文减少。

Conclusion: 研究提供了首个关于网页问题来源的历时性、出现级别测量，发现可爬取网页中的问题已从由人类提出转向为供机器阅读而制造。

Abstract: Questions scraped from the web are used across academia and industry as a proxy for what people want to know. Across QA training data, retrieval benchmarks, and content strategy, questions on a page are assumed to reflect human intent. We test this assumption at scale by extracting 13.4B question occurrences across 110 FineWeb snapshots (2013-2025), and report three findings. First, you can tell who is asking: provenance (the host/page of questions) leaves a signal in question form, and a logistic model can separate genuine user questions from templated/manufactured ones at AUC 0.725 via length and surrounding context rather than question type, though only 0.554 against commerce FAQ writing. Second, question frequency does not measure demand: the most-frequent questions are boilerplate/templated (over 70% of the top thousand), so occurrence counts measure how often a string was published and not how often it was asked. Third, over twelve years the genuine share of occurrences fell by 79% (42-56% after controlling for crawl composition), with question length and context decreasing. We present the first diachronic, occurrence-level measurement of web question provenance, and find the crawlable web's questions have shifted from being asked by humans toward manufactured for machines to read.

</details>


### [364] [Re:CAP - Auditing Retrieval Coverage in Production RAG Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24122)
*Aviral Joshi,Hanoz Bhathena,Max Nelson,Saket Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Re:CAP——一种无参考的迭代探测式检索覆盖审计方法，用于在生产 RAG 系统中发现被遗漏的文档，无需穷举相关性标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境 RAG 面临非平稳、百万级、实时重索引的语料，无法获得穷尽的相关性标签，导致检索质量研究不足且常被生成导向指标边缘化。传统评估需枚举所有相关文档，在此场景下不可行。

Method: Re:CAP（REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing）为无参考审计循环，作用于已部署 RAG 流水线的初始答案与检索上下文：识别已覆盖主题→针对可能缺失主题生成探测问题→检索候选文档→以 LLM-as-judge 仅保留引入先前未检索信息的文档，迭代进行。

Result: 在四个公开基准上，Re:CAP 找回平坦 BM25 top-500 无法触及的 9–29% 金标文档，TREC-COVID 上达 48%；MuSiQue 上较平坦混合 top-500 召回率高 +12.9 pp，且文档预算不足其一半。BM25+稠密+混合集成基线（各 top-500）在 TREC-COVID 仍遗漏 21.2% 金标文档，Re:CAP 将其找回；人工标注者判定其中 78.9% 的结构性差异文档为基线答案新增信息（Fleiss κ=0.79, n=123），生产流量上为 73.9%（n=180）。三次独立运行端到端召回可复现至 ±1%。

Conclusion: Re:CAP 通过探测缺失文档证据而非穷举相关文档来审计检索覆盖，在低文档预算下优于强基线，且结果可复现，可作为生产 RAG 定期检索审计的稳定工具。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is hard to monitor in production: exhaustive relevance labels do not exist for non-stationary multi-million-passage corpora that re-index in real time. As a result, retrieval quality is generally understudied and often deprioritised in favour of generation-oriented metrics. In this work, we propose auditing retrieval coverage by probing for evidence of missing documents rather than enumerating every relevant one. Our method Re:CAP (REtrieval Coverage Audit by iterative Probing) is a reference-free audit loop applied to a deployed RAG pipeline's initial answer and retrieved context: it identifies the topics already covered, generates probing questions for plausibly missing topics, retrieves candidate documents, and applies an LLM-as-judge to retain only those that introduce previously-unretrieved information. On four public benchmarks, Re:CAP recovers 9-29% of gold labels that flat BM25 top-500 cannot reach, rising to 48% on TREC-COVID. On MuSiQue Re:CAP beats flat hybrid top-500 by +12.9 pp on recall at less than half the document budget. An ensemble BM25, dense, and hybrid baseline (top-500 each) still leaves out 21.2% of gold docs on TREC-COVID that Re:CAP recovers; human annotators judge that 78.9% of those structurally distinct documents add new information to the baseline answer (Fleiss $κ$ = 0.79, n = 123), and 73.9% on live production traffic (n = 180). End-to-end recall is reproducible to within $\pm$1% across three independent runs, making Re:CAP a stable instrument for periodic retrieval audits.

</details>


### [365] [TAC-Time: Texts as Channels For Multimodal Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24156)
*Jiayi Liang,Xiaotian Gu,Xinyu Xie,Yuanbin Wu,Xiaoling Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TAC-Time框架，将文本信息转化为额外的时序通道，与数值序列在共享时序主干中联合建模，兼顾时序连续性、效率与可解释性，并在真实多模态基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序预测方法多仅依赖数值观测，忽略辅助文本中的丰富上下文信息；现有多模态方法或把文本当作静态特征，或以大语言模型作为预测主干，前者难以刻画时序动态，后者计算开销大。

Method: TAC-Time将文本特征转换为附加的时序通道，与数值序列在共享的时序主干网络中联合建模，从而在保持高效、可扩展的同时保留时序连续性与周期结构；该建模方式还支持系统化的可解释性分析（注意力与频域分析）。

Result: 通过注意力与频域分析揭示了强跨模态依赖关系，识别出具有预测性的文本信号，且相关性感知对齐可带来部分预测性能提升；在真实多模态基准上的大量实验表明TAC-Time优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 将文本转化为时序通道并与数值序列联合建模，是兼顾预测性能、计算效率与可解释性的有效多模态时序预测范式。

Abstract: Most existing time series forecasting methods rely solely on numerical observations, overlooking rich contextual information from auxiliary texts. Recent multimodal approaches attempt to incorporate textual signals, but they often treat text as static features or use large language models as forecasting backbones, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose TAC-Time, a unified framework that transforms textual information into additional temporal channels. By modeling text features jointly with numerical sequences in a shared temporal backbone, TAC-Time preserves temporal continuity and periodic structures while remaining efficient and scalable. This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.

</details>


### [366] [Efficient LLM Distillation for Bangladesh Legal Context: A Smartphone-Compatible Retrieval-Augmented Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24177)
*MD. Nafis Kamal,Mahadi Hasan Fahim,Talha Ridwan,Nadifa Zaman,Fariha Roushon Florin,Farig Yousuf Sadeque,Saadat Rafid Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将90亿参数的Gemma-2教师模型通过两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏压缩为20亿参数学生模型，结合稠密检索与BM25混合检索，在孟加拉国成文法问答中实现移动端离线部署，显著超越未蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉国法律信息对多数公民不可及：成文法文本仅为英文，受过训练的律师集中于城市中心，而依赖云端的AI在移动网络不稳定地区失效，且幻觉法律文本会直接造成危害。现有法律语言模型面向通用法律英语，未针对孟加拉国成文法。

Method: 两阶段渐进式知识蒸馏：第一阶段在9,429条经质量筛选的法律问答对（从14,514条生成查询中65%通过）上进行监督微调；第二阶段在温度τ=4.0下最小化对教师模型每token前50个logits的稀疏KL散度，通过QLoRA（4位NF4、rank-32 LoRA适配器）实现。所有回答经混合检索接地，结合稠密语义搜索（60%）与BM25（40%），覆盖孟加拉国宪法与国家立法的36,029个法条段落。

Result: 在50条英文查询基准上，蒸馏模型达到ROUGE-L 0.4715、BERTScore F1 0.5679，较检索增强的未蒸馏基线（ROUGE-L 0.2323、BERTScore 0.2340）分别提升103%与143%。适配器量化至1.6 GB（GGUF Q4_K_M），在Pixel 6上以4-8 tokens/秒运行且无需联网。50条孟加拉语查询的跨语言评估得到ROUGE-L 0.4083、BERTScore 0.8133。单评估者试点中，执业律师对50条回答加权均分4.16/5（90%评4或5分）。

Conclusion: 该系统专门面向孟加拉国成文法解释，通过蒸馏与混合检索实现离线移动端可用的法律问答，在文本重叠指标与律师人工评分上均显示实用价值；但其范围仅限成文法解释，依赖司法先例或判例推理的查询不在其覆盖范围内。

Abstract: Legal information in Bangladesh is inaccessible to most citizens. Statutory text is English-only, trained lawyers are concentrated in urban centres, and cloud-dependent AI fails where mobile connectivity is unreliable, a setting in which hallucinated legal text causes direct harm. The system addresses statutory interpretation only; queries that require judicial precedent or case-law reasoning fall outside its scope. We target the statutory access gap by compressing a 9-billion-parameter Gemma-2 teacher into a 2-billion-parameter student through two-phase progressive knowledge distillation. Phase 1 performs supervised fine-tuning on 9,429 quality-gated legal question-answer pairs (65% acceptance from 14,514 generated queries); Phase 2 minimises sparse Kullback-Leibler divergence against the teacher's top-50 per-token logits at temperature tau = 4.0, implemented via QLoRA (4-bit NF4, rank-32 LoRA adapters). Prior legal language models target general legal English; this system specialises in Bangladeshi statutory law. Every response is grounded through hybrid retrieval combining dense semantic search (60%) and BM25 (40%) across 36,029 statutory passages from the Bangladesh Constitution and national legislation. On a 50-query English benchmark, the distilled model reaches ROUGE-L 0.4715 and BERTScore F1 0.5679, a 103% ROUGE-L and 143% BERTScore gain over the retrieval-augmented undistilled baseline (ROUGE-L 0.2323, BERTScore 0.2340). The adapter quantises to 1.6 GB (GGUF Q4_K_M) and runs at 4-8 tokens per second on a Pixel 6 with no network access. Cross-lingual evaluation on 50 Bangla queries yields ROUGE-L 0.4083 and BERTScore 0.8133, showing effective retrieval from Bangla input against an English-only corpus. In a single-evaluator pilot, a practising lawyer rated 50 responses at a weighted mean of 4.16/5 (90% rated 4 or 5), supporting utility beyond text-overlap metrics.

</details>


### [367] [When Residualization Helps an Audit: Format Effects, Slice Gains, and Their Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24194)
*Daein Weon,Dongho Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文质疑对LLM评估分数（奖励模型、重排器、LLM评判者）进行"表面成分去除"（residualization）以提升效度的做法，指出其无法区分构造相关信号与表面信号，并通过干预实验、观察性复现和受控模型论证其风险，最终提出一套报告协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估分数可能追踪表面形式而非其声称的质量（如奖励模型仅以0.507的准确率——接近抛硬币——在简洁正确解与带注释的错误解之间选择）。业界日益流行从分数中减去可预测的表面成分，但作者认为仅靠去除并不产生更有效的测量：被去除的成分可能携带与构念相关的信号，而残差化本身无法辨别孰是孰非。

Method: 三类设计：(1) 干预实验——使用仅修改注释、由单元测试标注的MBPP样本，检验残差化对格式效应与正确/错误差距的影响；(2) 观察性设置（NLI与QA）——冻结留出复现集再进行打分，并用来自不相交标注者的标签重评；(3) 受控模型——检验对构念对齐同样有害的配置能否通过所有调整前检查。

Result: 干预实验：残差化将奖励模型的格式效应削弱约0.12（正确与错误代码上均是），而正确对错误的差距变动小于0.01，说明格式效应的降低并未带来构念对齐的改善。观察性设置：仅在预先声明的、纯表面预测器会犯错的切片上，构念标签一致性有所提升；但整体人群一致性在所有报告了正向切片增益的观察性设置中均下降，且在每一此类QA设置中问题内排序也下降，因此只支持"较窄的结论"，而非"修复后的分数"。受控模型：对构念对齐同样有害的配置能通过所有调整前检查，故不存在可靠的把关门槛。总体表明，当构念与表面特征纠缠时，残差化可能在去相关的同时损害构念对齐。

Conclusion: 作者将这些区别整合为一套报告协议，其产出（包括"拒绝报告"这一结果）需明确说明调整后分数可以被主张什么：调整后分数应作为审计时的诊断指标、与其所付出的构念对齐代价一并报告，而绝不能取代原始分数。

Abstract: Evaluation scores used around LLM systems -- including reward models, rerankers, and LLM judges -- can track surface form instead of the quality they claim to measure. When presented with a terse correct solution and a commented buggy solution for the same MBPP problem, a public preference reward model selects the correct one no better than a coin flip (0.507). Subtracting the predictable surface component from such scores is increasingly common, but removal alone does not yield a more valid measurement: the removed component may carry construct-relevant signal, and residualization cannot tell which is which. Under designed interventions -- unit-test labels with comment-only edits -- residualization attenuates the reward model's format effects by about 0.12 on both correct and buggy code, while the correct-versus-buggy margins move by less than 0.01. In observational NLI and QA settings, we freeze a held-out replication before scoring and re-evaluate it using labels from disjoint annotators; this supports only a narrower conclusion: better agreement with the construct labels on a pre-declared slice where a surface-only predictor errs, not a repaired score. Full-population agreement falls in every observational setting with a reported positive slice gain, and within-question ranking falls in every such QA setting. When construct and surface features are entangled, residualization can decorrelate a score while degrading construct alignment, and, in a controlled model, configurations just as damaging to construct alignment pass every pre-adjustment check, so no committed gate is a guarantee. We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.

</details>


### [368] [LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24196)
*Byeongho Yu,Junhyuk So,Eunhyeok Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LoopCD——环路级对比解码，通过在推理时利用LoopLM内部迭代动态对比早期与最终迭代的logits，无需训练即可提升推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoopLM虽通过共享权重递归精炼隐表示实现潜推理，但存在"环路不稳定"问题：迭代精炼不稳定会产生与推理错误相关的局部不确定"困难"token。

Method: LoopCD在推理时干预这些困难token，利用LoopLM内部动态，将早期迭代的logits与最后精炼迭代的logits进行对比，形成最终采样分布。

Result: 该方法高效，仅引入可忽略的推理开销，无需额外训练，通过自然地精炼推理关键的困难token有效提升推理性能；大量实验表明在多种推理任务上提升了近期代表性LoopLM的表现。

Conclusion: 环路级对比解码是提升LoopLM推理性能的高效无训练方案。

Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [369] [Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24199)
*Kaushal Santosh Bhogale,Srija Anand,Sadakopa Ramakrishnan Thothathiri,Tahir Javed,Sshubam Verma,Mitesh M. Khapra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出Vimarsha——覆盖印度全部22种官方语言、共100小时的ASR评测基准，同时纠正"干净音频导致分数虚高"和"转录标准过严导致分数虚低"两类系统性偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有印度语言ASR评测基准存在两类系统性偏差：一是基于干净、受控音频条件，导致评分过于乐观；二是转录标准过于僵化，惩罚合理的语言变体，导致评分过于悲观。二者均使评测结果无法反映真实性能。

Method: 构建Vimarsha基准（100小时、覆盖22种官方印度语言），包含两部分：具有人口统计学多样性的实地录制音频；面向声学难度筛选的"野外"音频。同时提出"变体格（lattice of variations）"框架，为每句话编码多种有效转录。

Result: 对10个最先进ASR模型的评测显示：在真实条件下模型排名出现显著变化；存在地理与人口统计学层面的性能差异；并呈现出跨语速与声学环境的系统性失效模式。

Conclusion: 真实、多样化的音频与灵活的多转录标准是更可靠ASR评测的关键；Vimarsha揭示了现有基准掩盖的排名变动、群体性能差距与系统性失效模式。

Abstract: Evaluation benchmarks for Indian language automatic speech recognition (ASR) suffer from two systematic biases: optimistic scores from clean, controlled audio conditions, and pessimistic scores from overly rigid transcription standards that penalize valid linguistic variations. We introduce Vimarsha, a 100-hour benchmark spanning all 22 scheduled Indian languages, designed to address both distortions. Vimarsha combines demographically diverse on-field recordings with carefully mined in-the-wild audio selected for acoustic difficulty, alongside a lattice of variations framework that encodes multiple valid transcriptions per utterance. Evaluations of 10 state-of-the-art ASR models reveal substantial shifts in model rankings under realistic conditions, geographic and demographic performance disparities, and systematic failure modes across speaking rates and acoustic environments.

</details>


### [370] [From Articles to Publishers: Aggregating Language Model Predictions for News Source Reliability Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24219)
*John Bianchi,Manuel Pratelli,Fabio Pinelli,Marinella Petrocchi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究将新闻来源可靠性推断建模为"来源级"预测问题，提出两阶段框架：先用Transformer模型估计单篇文章可靠性，再聚合文章级预测以推断未见出版商的可靠性，并在严格"出版商不重叠"评估协议下验证了聚合能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统新闻出版商可靠性评估依赖专家机构对编辑规范、透明度与事实标准的源头审查，成本高、难扩展。转为计算化方法后，现有工作多停留在"单篇文章"级别（用预标注文章训练、测试阶段评估），与真实的"来源级"部署需求不匹配，且常因训练/测试共享出版商而高估性能。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用基于Transformer的语言模型估计单篇文章的可靠性；第二阶段将文章级预测聚合，推断此前未见出版商的可靠性。为贴近真实部署条件，采用严格的"出版商不重叠"评估协议，确保无出版商同时出现在训练集与测试集中。数据为439家英文出版商的19,476篇政治新闻文章，标注采用NewsGuard可靠性评级。

Result: 聚合显著提升稳健性与性能：准确率从文章级约0.60提升至出版商级约0.69。此外，误差分析显示预测错误随政治倾向变化，政治立场与误分类模式之间存在统计显著关联。

Conclusion: 出版商可靠性可仅从聚合的文本信号中推断出来，支持可扩展、基于内容的自动化新闻来源评估方法；同时提示评估协议设计与政治倾向相关的偏差问题需要重视。

Abstract: Traditionally, the reliability of news publishers is assessed by expert organisations that evaluate editorial practices, transparency and factual standards at source. When this process is translated into a computational approach, the problem is often formulated at the level of individual articles, with models being trained on a set of pre-labelled articles and their performance being evaluated in a test phase. In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.

</details>


### [371] [Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24238)
*Guilhem Fouilhé,Nicholas Asher,Philippe Muller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文复现并压力测试 Yu et al. (2023) 关于语言模型在记忆知识与上下文矛盾信息间取舍的研究，在31个模型和额外5类知识关系上基本验证原结论，但发现实体频率效应、后训练影响等多项结论泛化性有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原研究（Yu et al., 2023）刻画了语言模型如何权衡记忆知识与矛盾的上下文陈述，但其结论是否稳健、能否推广到其他模型家族、规模及知识关系类型尚不明确，因此需要系统复现与压力测试。

Method: 在世界首都任务上复现原实验，覆盖 Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3、Ministral 四个家族共31个模型（含基座与后训练变体），并将评测扩展到 ParaConflict 数据集中的另外五类知识关系；通过模型规模、实体频率、后训练、问题措辞等变量进行压力测试。

Result: 实证证实了原研究的大部分发现：更大模型和高频实体倾向于偏好记忆答案，且存在显著的家族层面差异。但若干结论无法干净泛化：实体频率效应在 Qwen3-14B 和 32B 上消失；后训练对记忆—上下文权衡的偏移在不同家族间不一致；仅改变问题措辞即可使模型对记忆知识的依赖变化高达80个百分点；语义无关的文本也能模仿连贯的支持性上下文。

Conclusion: 研究明确了 Yu et al. 结论的成立边界及其对其他提示的泛化程度，表明记忆—上下文仲裁行为受模型家族、规模、措辞和上下文形式等多因素影响，原结论不能无差别推广。

Abstract: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

</details>


### [372] [Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24246)
*Akhil Sharma,Jatin Gupta,Ali Imam Abidi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向天体动力学领域的专用LLM框架Taramandal-GPT（基于Qwen3-8b，融合RAG与回退机制），并在自建APBench基准上通过数值与语义双重评估验证其竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大语言模型在自然语言理解上进展显著，但在天文学与天体动力学等专业领域受限于多步推理、符号运算和领域术语，效果不佳，因此需要领域适配的专用模型。

Method: 以Qwen3-8b为主干构建领域适配框架Taramandal-GPT，引入检索增强生成（RAG）流水线与回退机制以提升上下文精度；同时构建包含299道题、覆盖空间科学基础到进阶的APBench基准，并采用数值裕度打分与语义相似度评估的双重评价方法。

Result: 在APBench上，Taramandal-GPT相较当前先进的开源与闭源模型表现具有竞争力，在思维密集型（thinking-intensive）任务上优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 专用LLM对追求准确性与可解释性的领域具有重要价值，Taramandal-GPT是迈向天体物理、航天器工程与空间探索可靠AI助手的一步。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science.
